sentences.en: Programming Throwdown, episode number four.
sentences.zh: 编程脱口秀，第四期。

sentences.en: MATLAB and Octave.
sentences.zh: MATLAB 与 Octave。

sentences.en: Take it away, Jason.
sentences.zh: 你来主持吧，杰森。

sentences.en: Man, episode number four.
sentences.zh: 天哪，第四期。

sentences.en: It's pretty epic.
sentences.zh: 真是相当史诗级。

sentences.en: It's a milestone.
sentences.zh: 这是一个里程碑。

sentences.en: Four, yeah.
sentences.zh: 第四期，没错。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's eight weeks.
sentences.zh: 对，已经八周了。

sentences.en: Yeah, there we go.
sentences.zh: 对，就是这样。

sentences.en: Eight weeks.
sentences.zh: 八周。

sentences.en: Pretty soon we'll be at 140.
sentences.zh: 用不了多久我们就能到 140 期了。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's right.
sentences.zh: 对，没错。

sentences.en: We have, what is it, like over 150 downloads.
sentences.zh: 我们有多少下载量来着，好像超过 150 次了。

sentences.en: So quite a few of you have been listening, and so we appreciate that.
sentences.zh: 所以有不少人在听，我们对此非常感激。

sentences.en: Yeah, got a number of reviews on iTunes.
sentences.zh: 对，在 iTunes 上收到了不少评价。

sentences.en: Five stars.
sentences.zh: 五星好评。

sentences.en: Thank you all for doing that.
sentences.zh: 谢谢大家的支持。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's good times, good times.
sentences.zh: 对，那真是段好时光，好时光。

sentences.en: So I think there was something in the news about, like, Amazon with their, like, EC2, their cloud server went down.
sentences.zh: 所以我想新闻里好像有这么一件事，比如亚马逊的什么，比如他们的 EC2，他们的云服务器宕机了。

sentences.en: Did you see that one?
sentences.zh: 你看到了吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, it was all over the news all day.
sentences.zh: 看到了，一整天到处都是这条新闻。

sentences.en: Saw a bunch of that.
sentences.zh: 看到很多相关的消息。

sentences.en: Their web services went down.
sentences.zh: 他们的网络服务瘫痪了。

sentences.en: I guess it was all of them, their S3, EC2, all of them.
sentences.zh: 我猜是所有的服务，他们的 S3、EC2，全瘫痪了。

sentences.en: Oh, really?
sentences.zh: 噢，真的吗？

sentences.en: I thought it was just EC2.
sentences.zh: 我以为只有 EC2 呢。

sentences.en: Maybe.
sentences.zh: 也许吧。

sentences.en: Okay, I'm not really sure about that.
sentences.zh: 好吧，其实我太确定。

sentences.en: But, yeah, I saw that Amazon's stuff went down, and it's interesting how many popular websites now are actually running on top of Amazon's web service.
sentences.zh: 不过，对，我看到亚马逊的东西瘫痪了，有趣的是现在有多少热门网站实际上都在亚马逊的网络服务上运行。

sentences.en: I guess that's a praise of how good it really is.
sentences.zh: 我想这是对它到底有多好的一种赞誉。

sentences.en: But things like Quora, which is a question and answer site, was down.
sentences.zh: 但像问答网站 Quora 这样的一些服务也瘫痪了。

sentences.en: I know Heroku, which is a, was bought, who is it bought by?
sentences.zh: 我知道 Heroku，它是一个，被收购了，被谁收购来着？

sentences.en: Oh, well, it's a company that's a platform as a service, and they host, like, Ruby apps and stuff.
sentences.zh: 哦，好吧，它是一个平台即服务的公司，他们托管着 Ruby 应用之类的东西。

sentences.en: And I know they were down.
sentences.zh: 我知道它们当时也瘫痪了。

sentences.en: I think Dropbox was even having probleMs.
sentences.zh: 我想 Dropbox 甚至也遇到了问题。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Pretty much, you know, a large portion of the popular websites we go to and use every day use Amazon web services as a back end,
sentences.zh: 差不多可以说，我们每天访问和使用的很大一部分热门网站都使用亚马逊网络服务作为后端，

sentences.en: because they've done such a good job making it so cheap and reliable.
sentences.zh: 因为他们在将其变得如此廉价和可靠方面做得太出色了。

sentences.en: And then it goes down, and then it's like, uh-oh, the world comes to a halt.
sentences.zh: 然后它瘫痪了，接着大家就会觉得，糟了，世界要停摆了。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, this is similar to, what was that one company that started with an E that they did email surveys,
sentences.zh: 对，我是说，这有点类似于，那家以 E 开头的公司叫什么来着，他们做电邮调查，

sentences.en: and they got hacked, and as a result, your email and your name got leaked out.
sentences.zh: 结果被黑了，导致你们的电子邮件和姓名泄露了出去。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah, a couple weeks ago.
sentences.zh: 哦，对，几周前的事。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I know what you're talking about.
sentences.zh: 我知道你在说什么。

sentences.en: I got an email from TripAdvisor saying that my email got leaked out.
sentences.zh: 我收到了来自 TripAdvisor 的邮件，说我的邮箱泄露了。

sentences.en: And then I got one from the university that I was a student at, and then I got, and it's always the same exact email every time.
sentences.zh: 然后我收到了我曾就读的大学发来的邮件，然后我又收到，每次都是一模一样的邮件。

sentences.en: I got another one from, I think, American Airlines, and all of them used this one service that had an exploit.
sentences.zh: 我又收到了一封，好像是美国航空公司的邮件，所有这些公司都使用了某个存在漏洞的服务。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So it's common.
sentences.zh: 所以这很常见。

sentences.en: And it's surprising because a lot of people let their, what is it called, I guess, white labeling, right,
sentences.zh: 这让人惊讶，因为很多人让他们所谓的，这叫什么来着，我猜叫白标，对吧，

sentences.en: where you make a product, but then somebody else can basically put their own label on it or their own front end or hide it.
sentences.zh: 就是你做一个产品，但其他人基本上可以贴上他们自己的标签，或者加上他们自己的前端，或者把它隐藏起来。

sentences.en: It's not obvious to people that you're using their back end.
sentences.zh: 人们并不容易发现你在使用他们的后端。

sentences.en: And so, yeah, it's kind of interesting that when Amazon went down, all these websites that are completely unrelated to Amazon went down as well.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，这就挺有意思，当亚马逊宕机时，所有这些与亚马逊完全无关的网站也都跟着宕机了。

sentences.en: And the e-company was Epsilon.
sentences.zh: 那家 E 开头的公司是 Epsilon。

sentences.en: Oh, that's right.
sentences.zh: 哦，对。

sentences.en: Epsilon.
sentences.zh: Epsilon。

sentences.en: That's it.
sentences.zh: 就是它。

sentences.en: So, yeah, hopefully they'll come back.
sentences.zh: 所以，好吧，希望他们能恢复过来。

sentences.en: I guess maybe they're back by now.
sentences.zh: 我猜他们现在大概已经恢复了。

sentences.en: But, yeah, it was down for a couple hours or whatever, which is a pretty big deal with their increase in popularity.
sentences.zh: 不过，对，它瘫痪了几个小时左右，考虑到他们日益增长的受欢迎程度，这算是一件大事了。

sentences.en: I guess they've been down once before.
sentences.zh: 我记得他们以前好像也瘫痪过一次。

sentences.en: And when that happened, it was a while ago.
sentences.zh: 发生那次故障的时候是很久以前了。

sentences.en: They weren't quite as popular.
sentences.zh: 当时他们还没这么受欢迎。

sentences.en: And they came out and we were really apologetic and said, you know, we're not going to settle in making our product better until it's perfect.
sentences.zh: 他们站出来表达了深深的歉意，并说，你知道的，在我们的产品变得完美之前，我们绝不会停止改进。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I mean, the interesting thing about the Amazon cloud is just how accessible they've made it.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，关于亚马逊云，有趣的一点在于他们把门槛降得有多低。

sentences.en: I mean, there's that library, that Python library, PyCloud, where you can take Python code and run it on the Amazon cloud with, like, virtually no effort.
sentences.zh: 我是说，有那样一个库，那个 Python 库 PyCloud，你可以用几乎不费吹灰之力的方式，把 Python 代码拿到亚马逊云上去运行。

sentences.en: It just literally takes your function calls and tries to guesstimate.
sentences.zh: 它字面意思上就是获取你的函数调用并尝试进行估算。

sentences.en: I think you might have to provide it, like, what actual data you think that function is going to use.
sentences.zh: 我想你可能得向它提供，比如你认为该函数将使用什么实际数据。

sentences.en: But it handles, you know, sending it to the cloud, you know, and you can pull the cloud and say, are you done yet?
sentences.zh: 但它可以处理，你知道的，把它发送到云端，而且你可以轮询云端并问，搞定了吗？

sentences.en: Are you done yet?
sentences.zh: 搞定了吗？

sentences.en: And then as soon as it's done, it'll let you know.
sentences.zh: 然后一旦搞定，它就会通知你。

sentences.en: And so you can be using the cloud right now from Python and many other languages with just a trivial amount of work.
sentences.zh: 所以你现在就可以用 Python 以及许多其他语言，只需做一点微不足道的工作就能使用云服务了。

sentences.en: And that's very interesting.
sentences.zh: 这非常有趣。

sentences.en: It really puts a lot of power in our hands.
sentences.zh: 这确实赋予了我们巨大的能力。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And it's obviously lucrative for Amazon.
sentences.zh: 对亚马逊来说这显然很赚钱。

sentences.en: I saw some article.
sentences.zh: 我看到过一篇文章。

sentences.en: We don't have this in our news, but they were talking about that.
sentences.zh: 我们新闻里没提这个，但他们讨论过。

sentences.en: Oh, you're pointing out to me that Dropbox runs on top of Amazon storage and how much a year is in the millions that Dropbox is paying.
sentences.zh: 哦，你向我指出 Dropbox 是在亚马逊存储上运行的，Dropbox 每年支付的费用高达数百万美元。

sentences.en: Yeah, it was about $4 million a month.
sentences.zh: 对，大约是每月 400 万美元。

sentences.en: Oh, a month?
sentences.zh: 哦，一个月？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Oh, wow.
sentences.zh: 哦，哇。

sentences.en: I thought it was, like, per year.
sentences.zh: 我还以为是每年呢。

sentences.en: So, yeah, they're paying a lot of money to Amazon to others because it's so accessible.
sentences.zh: 所以，对，他们付给亚马逊很多钱，因为这太容易接触到了。

sentences.en: It's so easy to use, and they're doing it at a fair enough coSt.
sentences.zh: 它太好用了，而且他们的收费也算公道。

sentences.en: You know, it's cheap.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，很便宜。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So what have you been spending a large portion of your last day or two doing?
sentences.zh: 那你过去一两天里大部分时间都在花在哪上面了？

sentences.en: So I've been pretty into Portal 2.
sentences.zh: 所以我最近挺迷《传送门 2》的。

sentences.en: It was a lot of fun to play.
sentences.zh: 玩起来非常有趣。

sentences.en: I won't give any spoilers.
sentences.zh: 我不会剧透的。

sentences.en: Now, do we need to smoke?
sentences.zh: 话说，我们需要抽根烟吗？

sentences.en: I was going to ask.
sentences.zh: 我正想问呢。

sentences.en: No, no, I won't spoil anything, although I will say that the story is amazing.
sentences.zh: 不，不，我不会剧透任何东西，虽然我要说的是故事真的太棒了。

sentences.en: There are a lot of twists, which, you know, assuming that no one has spoiled it for you, you will find very enjoyable,
sentences.zh: 有很多反转，你知道的，假设没人向你剧透的话，你会觉得非常享受，

sentences.en: especially if you've played the first one because it requires sort of a lot of the knowledge from the first to fully appreciate the storyline.
sentences.zh: 特别是如果你玩过第一部的话，因为完全领略剧情需要第一部的大量背景知识。

sentences.en: But, yeah, so Portal 2 is kind of interesting.
sentences.zh: 不过，对，所以《传送门 2》挺有意思的。

sentences.en: So they preloaded all of the data for the game onto your machine when you pre-purchased the game.
sentences.zh: 当你预购游戏时，他们把游戏的所有数据都预先加载到你的机器上了。

sentences.en: So in my case, I pre-purchased it about a month ago, and it actually loaded all of the content at that time.
sentences.zh: 所以在我的情况下，我大约在一个月前预购了它，它当时确实把所有内容都加载进来了。

sentences.en: And Half-Life 2 did this as well.
sentences.zh: 《半条命 2》也是这么做的。

sentences.en: But one thing that Portal did that's unique is they encrypted all of the data.
sentences.zh: 但《传送门》做的一件独特的事是他们把所有数据都加密了。

sentences.en: So, you know, when I got up in the morning, the day Portal 2 was released, I guess three or four days ago,
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，在《传送门 2》发售那天早上我起床时，大概是三四天前吧，

sentences.en: I actually took about an hour, and it went through and decrypted all of the data that it had downloaded.
sentences.zh: 我实际上花了一个小时左右，让它把下载的所有数据都解密了一遍。

sentences.en: And then also, as part of decrypting, you know, downloaded the executable and started running.
sentences.zh: 然后作为解密的一部分，你知道的，它下载了可执行文件并开始运行。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有意思。

sentences.en: So what encouraged you – this is digitally available, right?
sentences.zh: 那是什么促使你——这是数字版发售的，对吧？

sentences.en: Whatever.
sentences.zh: 随便啦。

sentences.en: So what encouraged you to pre-buy it, give them your money early?
sentences.zh: 所以是什么促使你提前购买，把钱提前给他们？

sentences.en: So in this case, they gave a deal.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，他们提供了一个优惠。

sentences.en: Oh, okay.
sentences.zh: 哦，原来如此。

sentences.en: Yeah, so if you pre-purchased, you get 10% off, and you also got a free copy of Portal 1 that you could gift to somebody else.
sentences.zh: 对，如果你预购，可以打九折，你还会免费得到一份《传送门 1》的副本，可以送给别人。

sentences.en: Considering you probably already had Portal 1, if you were that interested in Portal 2.
sentences.zh: 考虑到如果你对《传送门 2》那么感兴趣，你可能已经有《传送门 1》了。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 对，确实。

sentences.en: So, yeah, Portal 2 actually had another interesting thing where originally they – you know, there was rumors that they were going to release the game on Friday,
sentences.zh: 所以，对，《传送门 2》其实还有另一个有趣的地方，最初他们——你知道的，有传言说他们要在周五发布游戏，

sentences.en: you know, a couple of Fridays ago.
sentences.zh: 几周前的那个周五。

sentences.en: And then they decided – or on Friday they announced that if you bought the Potato Pack,
sentences.zh: 然后他们决定——或者他们在周五宣布，如果你购买了“土豆包”，

sentences.en: which is a set, a collection of indie games, for each – for these little sort of achievements or little aspects of these different indie games that you accomplished,
sentences.zh: 也就是一套独立游戏的合集，为了达成这些不同的独立游戏的每一个成就或小要素，

sentences.en: you know, in one of them it was every time you beat a level, you would earn a potato.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，其中一个游戏里是你每通关一个关卡，就能赢得一个土豆。

sentences.en: And once a certain number of potatoes had been accumulated by the entire community, everyone on Steam, the Portal 2 game would become unlocked.
sentences.zh: 一旦整个社区（Steam 上的所有人）积累了特定数量的土豆，《传送门 2》这款游戏就会解锁。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有意思。

sentences.en: Yeah, so this is kind of a double-edged sword.
sentences.zh: 对，所以这是一把双刃剑。

sentences.en: A lot of people felt like, you know, we waited so long for this game, and now you're making us buy these games that we don't even want to play so that we can get to Portal 2.
sentences.zh: 很多人觉得，你知道的，我们为了这款游戏等了这么久，现在你们却逼我们买这些我们根本不想玩的游戏，只为了能玩到《传送门 2》。

sentences.en: But a lot of other people thought it was kind of fun and a little ingenious of them to, you know,
sentences.zh: 但也有很多人认为这挺好玩的，而且觉得他们这样做挺聪明的，

sentences.en: make some extra money and also, you know, provide some entertainment and give a little love to the people who make indie games.
sentences.zh: 既能赚点外快，也能提供一些娱乐，并对独立游戏制作者表达一点爱意。

sentences.en: Yeah, interesting.
sentences.zh: 对，有意思。

sentences.en: Now, one thing I was thinking about when I saw that we were going to be talking about Portal 2 was the fact that –
sentences.zh: 话说回来，当我看到我们要聊《传送门 2》时，我想到了的一点是——

sentences.en: I guess it was a couple months ago, it could have been longer now – when they originally had their release date and people were getting all excited,
sentences.zh: 我记得是几个月前，现在可能更久了——当时他们最初公布发售日期时，人们都兴奋不已，

sentences.en: and then Valve came out and said, you know – oh, is it Valve?
sentences.zh: 然后 Valve 出来说，你知道的——哦，是 Valve 吗？

sentences.en: I don't know, whoever?
sentences.zh: 我不知道，管他是谁？

sentences.en: Yeah, Valve.
sentences.zh: 对，Valve。

sentences.en: Oh, okay.
sentences.zh: 哦，好吧。

sentences.en: They came out and said that, yeah, it's going to be delayed.
sentences.zh: 他们出来说，对，游戏要跳票了。

sentences.en: Sorry, making software is harder than we thought – or is hard.
sentences.zh: 抱歉，做软件比我们想象的要难——或者说本来就很难。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And so I thought that was kind of interesting that they said, yeah, this is hard.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为挺有意思的是他们说，对，这很难。

sentences.en: It's going to take longer.
sentences.zh: 需要花更长时间。

sentences.en: You're going to make it awesome.
sentences.zh: 你们会把它做得超棒。

sentences.en: We're not going to release it any sooner.
sentences.zh: 我们不会提前发布的。

sentences.en: And that's interesting as a programmer, and I'm like, yay, that's true.
sentences.zh: 作为一个程序员，我觉得这很有意思，我就想，耶，确实如此。

sentences.en: Making software is hard.
sentences.zh: 做软件是很难的。

sentences.en: Oh, that sounded very enthusiastic.
sentences.zh: 哦，听起来真充满热情。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I mean, it's really hard to do software estimation, you know, saying how long is this function going to take to write?
sentences.zh: 所以，对，我的意思是，做软件工期估算真的很难，你知道的，要说清写这个函数需要多长时间？

sentences.en: How long is this level going to take to make?
sentences.zh: 做这个关卡需要多长时间？

sentences.en: How long is it going to take to test this feature?
sentences.zh: 测试这个功能需要多长时间？

sentences.en: It's hard to estimate that, especially if you're doing something new or never been done before.
sentences.zh: 很难估算，特别是如果你在做一些新的或以前从未做过的事情时。

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, really, at this level, programming is almost an art.
sentences.zh: 对，我是说，真的，在这个层面上，编程几乎成了一种艺术。

sentences.en: And, you know, in general, you just cannot put a time on, you know, art.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，一般来说，你就是无法为艺术设定一个时间。

sentences.en: It's just that there's a level of creativity.
sentences.zh: 这里面包含着一种创造力。

sentences.en: And often it's – there's just no such thing as perfect, you know.
sentences.zh: 而且通常——根本就没有完美这回事，你知道的。

sentences.en: You can – you know, if you have a function and it needs to add two numbers or whatever, then there is, you know, obviously a perfect answer to that.
sentences.zh: 你可以——你知道的，如果你有一个函数，它需要把两个数字加起来或者干嘛的，那么显然，这里面有一个完美的答案。

sentences.en: But often things come down to –
sentences.zh: 但通常事情往往归结于——

sentences.en: Maybe not, but most of the time.
sentences.zh: 也许不见得，但大多数时候是这样的。

sentences.en: Yeah, it depends what world you're living in.
sentences.zh: 对，这取决于你生活在哪个世界。

sentences.en: But, you know, often these come down to design choices.

sentences.zh: 不，这其实是有人拿乐高用乐高搭了一条装配线。

sentences.en: What?
sentences.zh: 什么？

sentences.en: Wait, wait, wait.
sentences.zh: 等等，等等，等等。

sentences.en: So they assemble Legos with Legos.
sentences.zh: 所以他们用乐高来组装乐高。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Is that right?
sentences.zh: 是这样吗？

sentences.en: Okay, okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧，好吧。

sentences.en: I gotta keep track of this.
sentences.zh: 我得跟上这个。

sentences.en: It's like meta.
sentences.zh: 这太套娃了。

sentences.en: Okay, hang on.
sentences.zh: 好吧，等等。

sentences.en: Keep going.
sentences.zh: 继续。

sentences.en: All right, keep going.
sentences.zh: 好吧，继续。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think this counts as, you know, the first, like, reproductive organ that's ever been made out of Lego.
sentences.zh: 对，我觉得这算得上是，你知道的，有史以来第一个用乐高制造的生殖器官。

sentences.en: Because now he's able to...
sentences.zh: 因为现在它能够……

sentences.en: If it can produce itself, then we have a complete species here of Lego.
sentences.zh: 如果它能自我复制，那我们就拥有了一个完整的乐高物种。

sentences.en: Uh-oh.
sentences.zh: 噢哦。

sentences.en: I, for one, welcome our Lego overlords.
sentences.zh: 我个人而言，欢迎我们的乐高统治者。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, yeah, you guys should definitely visit the blog and check this link out.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，你们绝对应该去看看那个博客并点开这个链接。

sentences.en: Yeah, it has a killer video.
sentences.zh: 对，里面有一个超赞的视频。

sentences.en: So, um, you know, it just, it sounds like the big dog robot walking because all these different Mindstorm...
sentences.zh: 所以，嗯，你知道的，它听起来就像大狗机器人走路的声音，因为所有这些不同的机器人发明家系列……

sentences.en: Big dog's awesome.
sentences.zh: 大狗机器人太棒了。

sentences.en: Yeah, all these different Mindstorm parts, um, axes.
sentences.zh: 对，所有这些不同的机器人发明家系列零件，嗯，轴。

sentences.en: So can it rebuild itself?
sentences.zh: 所以它能自我重建吗？

sentences.en: No, it's...
sentences.zh: 不，它是……

sentences.en: Or it just builds other things?
sentences.zh: 还是说它只是建造别的东西？

sentences.en: Yeah, right now it just, um, it's pretty simplistic.
sentences.zh: 对，现在它只是，嗯，挺简单的。

sentences.en: It only has four robot arms, um, but it can, I think it can build, uh, it builds these little cars.
sentences.zh: 它只有四个机器人手臂，嗯，但它可以，我想它可以建造，嗯，它能造这些小车。

sentences.en: Oh, that's kind of cool.
sentences.zh: 哦，那挺酷的。

sentences.en: Yeah, it can build, like, a block.
sentences.zh: 对，它可以造一个方块之类的东西。

sentences.en: It can take Legos and build, like, essentially a bigger Lego, like a macro Lego block by stacking several of these together.
sentences.zh: 它可以拿乐高拼出一个，基本上更大的乐高，就像一个宏观的乐高积木，通过把其中几个叠在一起。

sentences.en: Yeah, I got interested recently in, uh, I guess it's called the RepRap, which is the idea of a replicating machine that can replicate itself.
sentences.zh: 对，我最近对，嗯，我想它叫RepRap的东西很感兴趣，这是一种复制机的概念，可以自我复制。

sentences.en: Mm-hmm.
sentences.zh: 嗯哼。

sentences.en: So it prints, it prints parts, and it prints parts for itself so it can make new itselfs.
sentences.zh: 所以它打印零件，打印它自己的零件，这样它就能创造出新的自己。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And then that drives down costs because if you can do it perfectly,
sentences.zh: 然后这会拉低成本，因为如果你能完美地做到这一点，

sentences.en: you can end up making them really cheap because then you end up having lots and lots of things that can make more of those things.
sentences.zh: 你最终能把它们造得非常便宜，因为那样你就会拥有大量能够制造更多那种东西的东西。

sentences.en: And, you know, it becomes really awesome.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，这变得非常厉害。

sentences.en: And it's really clever because they have parts that, at this point in time, they're not able to print.
sentences.zh: 而且它真的很聪明，因为它们有一些零件，在目前这个时间点，它们还无法打印出来。

sentences.en: So, like, circuit boards, metal rods, screws, things like that, or things that are economically prohibitive to print.
sentences.zh: 所以，比如电路板、金属杆、螺丝之类的东西，或者是打印成本在经济上不划算的东西。

sentences.en: But, um, and then they call those things vitamins, which is things your body needs but can't make.
sentences.zh: 但是，嗯，然后他们把这些东西叫做维生素，也就是你身体需要却无法自己制造的东西。

sentences.en: So I thought it was kind of clever, and it's really interesting.
sentences.zh: 所以我认为这挺聪明的，而且真的很有趣。

sentences.en: Maybe I'll have to talk about that sometime.
sentences.zh: 也许我以后得找机会聊聊这个。

sentences.en: But, yeah, this sounds like not quite the same thing because it can't make its own self out of Legos, which would be even cooler.
sentences.zh: 但是，对，这听起来不太一样，因为它不能用乐高自我复制，那样会更酷。

sentences.en: But maybe it's a step in that direction.
sentences.zh: 但也许这是朝那个方向迈出的一步。

sentences.en: Maybe it's something to inspire it and make its own bootstrapping Lego factory.
sentences.zh: 也许这能带来灵感，打造它自己的自举式乐高工厂。

sentences.en: And then one day, giant Lego robots will appear outside of our house and knock, knock, knock.
sentences.zh: 然后有一天，巨大的乐高机器人会出现在我们房子外面，敲、敲、敲。

sentences.en: We've come to take over.
sentences.zh: 我们来接管了。

sentences.en: Give us your children.
sentences.zh: 把你们的孩子交出来。

sentences.en: Uh-oh.
sentences.zh: 噢哦。

sentences.en: That would be good.
sentences.zh: 那倒挺好的。

sentences.en: But, yeah, you know, it's really interesting how with Lego Mindstorms you can do just about anything.
sentences.zh: 不过，对，你知道的，乐高机器人发明家系列真的很神奇，用它你几乎可以做任何事。

sentences.en: You know, it's a – I believe Lego Mindstorms, it's its own language, right?
sentences.zh: 你知道，它是一个——我相信乐高机器人发明家系列有它自己的语言，对吧？

sentences.en: Have you noticed it?
sentences.zh: 你注意到了吗？

sentences.en: No, I haven't, but I know that they have – in typical over-the-top nerd fashion, I think people do a lot with it.
sentences.zh: 不，我没有，但我知道他们有——以典型的极客特质，我觉得人们用它做了很多事。

sentences.en: But I think originally it came out, and I remember it being a visual language.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得它刚出来的时候，我记得它是一种可视化语言。

sentences.en: So you actually had, like, little parts that you would drop on for an if statement or a loop, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以你实际上有，比如，可以拖放的小部件来实现if语句或循环，你知道的，

sentences.en: and you could drop those little blocks down, and then it would go to the little brain, the controller brick,
sentences.zh: 你可以把那些小方块放下来，然后它就会传送到那个小脑瓜，也就是控制器积木，

sentences.en: or I'm not sure what their term is for it, and it would control the other Legos.
sentences.zh: 或者我不太确定他们是怎么称呼它的，然后它就会控制其他乐高。

sentences.en: But now I think they even have the ability – and then they had a language you could write in.
sentences.zh: 但现在我觉得它们甚至有了能力——而且以前它们有一种你可以用来编写的语言。

sentences.en: But I think people even have where you can write in C now.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得现在人们甚至可以用C语言编写了。

sentences.en: Yeah, according to Wikipedia, you can write in Java and C now.
sentences.zh: 对，根据维基百科，你现在可以用Java和C语言编写了。

sentences.en: Nice.
sentences.zh: 不错。

sentences.en: For Mindstorms, yeah.
sentences.zh: 针对机器人发明家系列，对。

sentences.en: And so this is really interesting that – So if you listen to our first podcast, then you'll have the language C under your belt.
sentences.zh: 所以这真的很有趣——所以如果你听了我们的第一期播客，那你手里就掌握了C语言。

sentences.en: You'll know what you're doing, and then you can go program a Lego factory to replicate itself.
sentences.zh: 你会知道自己在做什么，然后你就可以去给一个乐高工厂编程，让它自我复制。

sentences.en: Yeah, if you do that, definitely let us know.
sentences.zh: 对，如果你做到了，一定要让我们知道。

sentences.en: Yeah, we will have you on the show if you can build a self-replicating Lego factory.
sentences.zh: 对，如果你能造出一个自我复制的乐高工厂，我们会邀请你上节目。

sentences.en: That would be epic.
sentences.zh: 那可就太史诗级了。

sentences.en: Especially if you learn about C from us.
sentences.zh: 特别是如果你是从我们这儿学的C语言。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，对。

sentences.en: That would be even better.
sentences.zh: 那就更棒了。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 对，对。

sentences.en: Or tell your friends, and maybe they'll learn about C, and then go do this in maybe a year or two or three or four.
sentences.zh: 或者告诉你的朋友，也许他们会学习C语言，然后在大概一两年或三四年后去把这个做出来。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I mean, a lot of these robotics problems are problems that actually you'll encounter, like you guys who are in computer science at university or at high school.
sentences.zh: 所以，对，我的意思是，很多这样的机器人学问题，其实就是你们这些在大学或高中学计算机科学的人会遇到的问题。

sentences.en: So, you know, something like path planning.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道，比如路径规划。

sentences.en: You know, when you do path planning, you might look at just a little, you know, circle in a maze trying to get through this maze.
sentences.zh: 你知道，当你做路径规划时，你可能会看到迷宫里的一个小圆圈，试图穿过这个迷宫。

sentences.en: And you might not be thinking about real applications.
sentences.zh: 而你可能不会去想实际的应用。

sentences.en: You might think, well, when in real life am I ever going to be in a maze?
sentences.zh: 你可能会想，现实生活中我什么时候才会进迷宫？

sentences.en: I mean, it's just silly.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这太傻了。

sentences.en: It was at one time.
sentences.zh: 曾经有那么一次。

sentences.en: Oh, yeah.
sentences.zh: 哦，对。

sentences.en: A minute time?
sentences.zh: 有一分钟？

sentences.en: Oh, man.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: That was rough.
sentences.zh: 那太惨了。

sentences.en: I really wish we had a laptop there to run for our lives.
sentences.zh: 我真希望当时我们在那儿有个笔记本电脑好逃命。

sentences.en: I should have studied better that A-star algorithm.
sentences.zh: 我当时真该好好学学A星算法。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's right.
sentences.zh: 对，没错。

sentences.en: But, you know, robotics, the way the robot arm moves is actually path planning.
sentences.zh: 但是，你知道，机器人学中机器人手臂移动的方式其实就是路径规划。

sentences.en: So you have the robot arm, sort of the positions that it wants to be in as sort of the goal, the exit of the maze, and where it is now as the start of the maze.
sentences.zh: 所以你有机器人手臂，把它的目标位置当作迷宫的出口，把当前位置当作迷宫的入口。

sentences.en: And sometimes, you know, it has to move to the right so that it can swing to the left without hitting a wall.
sentences.zh: 有时，你知道，它必须向右移动，这样它才能向左摆动而不会撞到墙。

sentences.en: Probably the different joints.
sentences.zh: 可能是不同的关节。

sentences.en: Yeah, exactly.
sentences.zh: 对，完全正确。

sentences.en: Kind of like an octopus arm, you know.
sentences.zh: 有点像章鱼的触手，你知道的。

sentences.en: So there's an example of where, you know, algorithms that you see in computer science school that you think, you know, who's ever going to use this?
sentences.zh: 所以这就举了个例子，你在计算机科学学校里学到的一些算法，你会想，谁会用得到这个？

sentences.en: And then you find out later in life, oh, everyone uses this, you know.
sentences.zh: 然后你长大后发现，哦，每个人都在用这个，你知道的。

sentences.en: Plus, let's admit it, robots are awesome.
sentences.zh: 另外，承认吧，机器人太棒了。

sentences.en: Yep.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Robots make anything cooler.
sentences.zh: 机器人让任何东西都更酷。

sentences.en: I think every comp sci class should have a Lego Mindstorm.
sentences.zh: 我觉得每一门计算机科学课程都应该配备一个乐高机器人发明家系列。

sentences.en: And lasers.
sentences.zh: 还有激光。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And, well, I was going to give a Portal 2 spoiler.
sentences.zh: 而且，好吧，我本来想剧透《传送门2》来着。

sentences.en: No, stop!
sentences.zh: 不，住手！

sentences.en: Stop, stop, stop.
sentences.zh: 住手，住手，住手。

sentences.en: We'll just stop with robots and lasers.
sentences.zh: 我们还是只谈机器人和激光好了。

sentences.en: And portals.
sentences.zh: 还有传送门。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: I haven't played it, so if I give out any spoilers, it's completely accidental.
sentences.zh: 我没玩过，所以如果我剧透了什么，那完全是意外。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, what is your tool of the bi-week?
sentences.zh: 那么，你双周推荐的工具是什么？

sentences.en: So, on robots and building things and, you know, atoms as opposed to bits, my tool of the week is going a little bit different with the Texas Instruments MSP430.
sentences.zh: 所以，关于机器人和造东西，以及原子而不是比特，我本周推荐的工具有点不同，是德州仪器的MSP430。

sentences.en: Don't you love it when companies name things cleverly?
sentences.zh: 你不觉得公司给产品起名字很有创意的时候很棒吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, I was going to say, I mean, now I know exactly what that is.
sentences.zh: 对，我正要说，我的意思是，现在我完全知道那是什么了。

sentences.en: Yeah, don't you?
sentences.zh: 对，不是吗？

sentences.en: I'm so glad.
sentences.zh: 我太高兴了。

sentences.en: That's just the mind meld that's going on here between TI and us.
sentences.zh: 这就是德州仪器和我们之间产生的思想共鸣。

sentences.en: So, this is kind of interesting.
sentences.zh: 所以，这个挺有趣的。

sentences.en: I've used before another product that's kind of in the same vein as this called the Arduino.
sentences.zh: 我以前用过另一个产品，跟这个有点类似，叫做Arduino。

sentences.en: And the Arduino is an Atmega chip with a bootloader and a little board that comes with it.
sentences.zh: Arduino是一个带有引导程序和一个随附小板的Atmega芯片。

sentences.en: And for, I think, it's like $20.
sentences.zh: 而且，我觉得，只要大约20美元。

sentences.en: And an awesome interface.
sentences.zh: 还有一个超赞的接口。

sentences.en: And they made it all open hardware.
sentences.zh: 他们把所有硬件都开源了。

sentences.en: And it's pretty cool.
sentences.zh: 而且它相当酷。

sentences.en: And you can use it to do all sorts of interesting things.
sentences.zh: 你可以用它来做各种有趣的事情。

sentences.en: And there's a great community that was built up around it.
sentences.zh: 并且围绕它建立了一个很棒的社区。

sentences.en: And I really like the Arduino.
sentences.zh: 我真的很喜欢Arduino。

sentences.en: People used to do a lot of things.
sentences.zh: 人们以前用它做过很多事情。

sentences.en: But kind of similar to the Lego Mindstorms where people use stuff for more than it's intended to.
sentences.zh: 但有点类似于乐高机器人发明家系列，人们把东西用得超出了它的原本意图。

sentences.en: And kind of do a lot of work instead of picking the right tool for the job or learning the next thing.
sentences.zh: 并且做了很多工作，而不是为这项工作选择正确的工具或者学习新的东西。

sentences.en: They use what they have and do really creative.
sentences.zh: 他们用手头的东西做出了非常有创意的事情。

sentences.en: But if all you have is a hammer, everything becomes a nail, right?
sentences.zh: 但如果你手里只有一把锤子，任何东西看起来都像钉子，对吧？

sentences.en: So, people use Arduino to do a lot of things that are really clever and cool.
sentences.zh: 所以，人们用Arduino做了很多非常聪明和酷炫的事情。

sentences.en: But it could probably be done more easily or cheaper.
sentences.zh: 但其实可以更简单或更便宜地完成。

sentences.en: Because one of the things is even though Arduino is cheap at $20 or so, depending on what version you get.
sentences.zh: 因为其中一点是，尽管Arduino只要20美元左右，取决于你买的是哪个版本，其实挺便宜的。

sentences.en: It's not something you want to leave in a project or leave in something.
sentences.zh: 但它也不是那种你想留在某个项目里或者留在什么东西里不管的东西。

sentences.en: Or, you know, because it's $20.
sentences.zh: 或者，你知道的，因为它要20美元。

sentences.en: I mean, that's kind of, you know, I don't want to just go wasting $20 all the time.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，那有点，你知道的，我可不想一直白白浪费20美元。

sentences.en: And so, the Texas Instruments response to that is to try to build up a community around some of their products.
sentences.zh: 所以，德州仪器对此的回应是试图围绕他们的一些产品建立一个社区。

sentences.en: And they do, you know, they're like, you know, dominant in the DSP market for industry.
sentences.zh: 而且他们确实，你知道的，他们在工业数字信号处理器市场上占据主导地位。

sentences.en: And so, they say, how do we get to these consumers?
sentences.zh: 所以他们说，我们如何接触到这些消费者？

sentences.en: Because these consumers, these people in college, they will eventually work in companies.
sentences.zh: 因为这些消费者，这些大学里的人，他们最终会在公司里工作。

sentences.en: And they'll be able to do stuff like, you know, themselves.
sentences.zh: 而且他们能够自己去做一些事情，你知道的。

sentences.en: And plus, these, you know, chips a lot of times are very cheap for them to make.
sentences.zh: 而且另外，你知道的，这些芯片对他们来说很多时候制作成本非常便宜。

sentences.en: So, if they can sell a kit for it, you know, more power to them.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果他们能为此卖出一套套件，你知道的，那就太棒了。

sentences.en: It's awesome.
sentences.zh: 这太棒了。

sentences.en: And so, this MSP430 thing that they have now, the launch pad.
sentences.zh: 所以，他们现在有的这个 MSP430 东西，那个启动板。

sentences.en: Oh, I guess this will actually be my 12-week MSP430 launch pad.
sentences.zh: 哦，我想这实际上将是我的第 12 周 MSP430 启动板。

sentences.en: It is kind of an Arduino competitor that sells for $4.30, shipped to your door, you know, everything included.
sentences.zh: 它有点像 Arduino 的竞争产品，售价 4.30 美元，直接送到你家门口，你知道的，包含所有东西。

sentences.en: That's awesome.
sentences.zh: 那太棒了。

sentences.en: So, I can't recall when I bought mine, but I think it even had a USB connector in it.
sentences.zh: 所以，我记不清我是什么时候买的了，但我想它甚至还带有一个 USB 接口。

sentences.en: Oh, you have one of these?
sentences.zh: 哦，你有一个这个？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So, I have one of these.
sentences.zh: 所以，我有一个这个。

sentences.en: I've not done too much with it, but it is pretty cool.
sentences.zh: 我用它做的事不多，但它确实挺酷的。

sentences.en: Oh, it says $430 plus shipping.
sentences.zh: 哦，上面写着 430 美元加运费。

sentences.en: Maybe that's changed its idea.
sentences.zh: 也许它的想法变了。

sentences.en: But I don't think shipping is very much.
sentences.zh: 但我觉得运费应该不会很贵。

sentences.en: It's pretty small.
sentences.zh: 它挺小的。

sentences.en: But it's a pretty nice kit.
sentences.zh: 但它是一个相当不错的套件。

sentences.en: And it's interesting because at only $4.30, it's a little easier to leave that in a project now.
sentences.zh: 而且很有趣，因为只要 4.30 美元，现在把这东西留在项目里就变得更容易了。

sentences.en: And it's not exactly the same as Arduino, but it's kind of similar.
sentences.zh: 它和 Arduino 不完全一样，但有点类似。

sentences.en: And, you know, we do a lot of open source tools or free things for the tool of the week.
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，我们在每周工具栏目中做了很多开源工具或免费的东西。

sentences.en: But this is something that's really cheap and really cool because I remember being in, you know, high school and being interested in electronics and, you know,
sentences.zh: 但这是真的很便宜又很酷的东西，因为我记得当我在，你知道的，上高中时，对电子产品感兴趣，并且，你知道的，

sentences.en: making things out of magazines.
sentences.zh: 用杂志上的东西来制作物件。

sentences.en: There's not a lot of that today at that level.
sentences.zh: 现在那个水平的这种东西不多了。

sentences.en: But there's a lot of stuff on the Internet today that we didn't have when we were growing up.
sentences.zh: 但现在互联网上有很多我们小时候没有的东西。

sentences.en: And so, something like this, when you're, you know, younger, you know, your parents don't necessarily mind giving you $5 for something or whatever.
sentences.zh: 所以，当你在，你知道的，更年轻的时候，有这样的东西，你知道的，你的父母不一定介意给你 5 美元买个什么东西之类的。

sentences.en: And then, you know, use their permission.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道的，征得他们的同意。

sentences.en: And then maybe they'll let you – they can put in their credit card information for you so that you can get one of these.
sentences.zh: 然后也许他们会让你——他们可以为你输入他们的信用卡信息，这样你就能买一个这个。

sentences.en: But that's pretty cool for $4.30.
sentences.zh: 但花 4.30 美元买这个真是太酷了。

sentences.en: It'll be a lot of stuff you can learn with this, you know, writing code in C, actually.
sentences.zh: 用这个你可以学到很多东西，你知道的，实际上是用 C 语言写代码。

sentences.en: It might do C++, but they give you their – a version of their Code Composer, which is their product that you use for, like, the higher-end DSPs that, you know,
sentences.zh: 它或许能用 C++，但他们提供的是他们的——他们的代码编写器（Code Composer）的一个版本，这是他们的产品，用于类似高端 DSP 的用途，你知道的，

sentences.en: people use at their jobs and stuff.
sentences.zh: 人们在工作中使用之类的。

sentences.en: And they provide that, and you're able to use it to write C code to do stuff like, you know, play with – instead of just making a loop that prints hello world, that's kind of cool.
sentences.zh: 他们提供了这个，你能用它来写 C 代码做一些事情，你知道的，比如玩——不仅仅是写一个打印 hello world 的循环，那挺酷的。

sentences.en: But, I don't know.
sentences.zh: 但是，我不知道。

sentences.en: There's something different about writing instead of print hello world, turn LED, toggle LED.
sentences.zh: 写代码除了打印 hello world 之外，还有点不同，比如点亮 LED，切换 LED。

sentences.en: Like, it's just cool.
sentences.zh: 就像，这真的很酷。

sentences.en: It's just nice to see something in the real world other than your screen, you know, doing awesome things.
sentences.zh: 能看到现实世界中除了屏幕之外的东西在做很棒的事情，感觉真好。

sentences.en: It's hooking up a servo and making – watching it move or, you know, affecting things.
sentences.zh: 那是连接一个舵机并制作——看着它移动，或者，你知道的，对事物产生影响。

sentences.en: It's fun.
sentences.zh: 这很有趣。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: I'm kind of into – I know you're a little bit more high-level software than I am, but –
sentences.zh: 我有点喜欢——我知道你比我更偏向于高层软件，但是——

sentences.en: Yeah, I wish – you know, it's something I want to get more into.
sentences.zh: 对，我希望——你知道的，这是我想深入了解的东西。

sentences.en: I just – I'm kind of ignorant on it right now, but I am really interested.
sentences.zh: 我只是——我现在对它有点无知，但我真的很感兴趣。

sentences.en: How does it – so, I might show the ignorance here, but let's say you have a servo that you want to communicate with.
sentences.zh: 它是怎么——所以，我在这里可能会显露出无知，但假设你有一个想要与之通信的舵机。

sentences.en: Do you have to buy a TI servo, or – I mean, is there a library, or how does this work?
sentences.zh: 你必须买一个德州仪器的舵机，还是——我的意思是，有没有库，或者这到底是怎么运作的？

sentences.en: So, on MSP430, there probably is example code out there.
sentences.zh: 所以，在 MSP430 上，外面可能就有示例代码。

sentences.en: If not, it's not that hard.
sentences.zh: 如果没有，其实也没那么难。

sentences.en: But, no, so, what happens is servos are controlled by something called pulse width modulation, which is a programming show, so maybe this is out of context.
sentences.zh: 但是，不，所以，实际情况是舵机是由一种叫做脉冲宽度调制的东西控制的，这是一个编程节目，所以这可能有些脱离语境。

sentences.en: But, oh, wow, we're going to learn something new today.
sentences.zh: 但是，哦，哇，我们今天能学到新东西了。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So, pulse width modulation, which is given a set – and I'm going to flub this up for any electrical engineers listening, so tune out now.
sentences.zh: 所以，脉冲宽度调制，它被赋予了一个设定值——如果有任何电气工程师在听，我肯定会把这讲砸，所以现在就别听了。

sentences.en: Please resume this in about three to four minutes.
sentences.zh: 请在大约三到四分钟后再收听。

sentences.en: This is like an anti-spoiler.
sentences.zh: 这就像一个反剧透。

sentences.en: It's like we know we're not going to spoil anything good on electrical engineering.
sentences.zh: 就像我们知道我们不会剧透任何关于电气工程的好东西一样。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: So, the idea is you've got a set rate.
sentences.zh: 所以，核心思路是你有一个设定的频率。

sentences.en: So, let's say, you know, every one hertz, you're going to have a cycle, once per second, just to make it easy.
sentences.zh: 所以，假设，你知道的，每隔一赫兹，你就会有一个周期，每秒一次，为了简单起见。

sentences.en: It would never be that long because that would be too much delay between signals.
sentences.zh: 它绝不会那么长，因为那样信号之间的延迟会太大了。

sentences.en: But, so, you have one second cycle rate.
sentences.zh: 但是，所以，你有一个一秒钟的周期率。

sentences.en: So, the servo will say, for instance, center position.
sentences.zh: 所以，舵机会说，比方说，中心位置。

sentences.en: It will be a 50% on, 50% off.
sentences.zh: 它将是 50% 开启，50% 关闭。

sentences.en: So, if 50% of the pulse width, so that time of one second, if for 500 milliseconds, the pulse is high and the rest is low,
sentences.zh: 所以，如果脉冲宽度的 50%，也就是一秒钟的时间里，有 500 毫秒脉冲是高的，其余是低的，

sentences.en: it's going to be centered in the center position of the servo.
sentences.zh: 它就会居中在舵机的中心位置。

sentences.en: Because the servo goes from a plus degrees to a minus degrees.
sentences.zh: 因为舵机的活动范围是从正度数到负度数。

sentences.en: It normally doesn't do continuous rotation.
sentences.zh: 它通常不作连续旋转。

sentences.en: If you make the signal less than 50%, you normally have it centered in your window, so it's a little hump in the middle.
sentences.zh: 如果你让信号小于 50%，你通常会把它居中在你的窗口里，所以中间有一个小凸起。

sentences.en: So, if you have it for 250 milliseconds, that, depending on the servo, could be full over left.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你让它持续 250 毫秒，根据舵机的不同，那可能是完全向左。

sentences.en: And if you have it for 750 milliseconds, that could be full over right.
sentences.zh: 如果你让它持续 750 毫秒，那可能是完全向右。

sentences.en: And so, varying that width of the pulse allows you to control the position of the servo.
sentences.zh: 因此，改变脉冲的宽度可以让你控制舵机的位置。

sentences.en: And then the servo holds its position once it's there by itself.
sentences.zh: 然后舵机一旦到达那个位置，就会自己保持住这个位置。

sentences.en: It knows, if you keep sending that pulse, it knows how to stay there.
sentences.zh: 它知道，如果你一直发送那个脉冲，它就知道该如何保持在那里。

sentences.en: And if somebody tries to go move it or push against it, it'll try to move back to the right place.
sentences.zh: 如果有人试图去移动它或推它，它会试图移回正确的位置。

sentences.en: So, it's a closed-loop thing in itself.
sentences.zh: 所以它本身就是一个闭环系统。

sentences.en: And that pulse width is a way of communicating to it.
sentences.zh: 而那个脉冲宽度就是与它通信的一种方式。

sentences.en: So, in that way, you can buy any pulse width modulated servo and it'll work.
sentences.zh: 所以，通过这种方式，你可以买任何脉冲宽度调制的舵机，它都能工作。

sentences.en: Now, there are newer servos which communicate, for instance, like on I2C or something, which is another protocol, so it wouldn't have to be specific.
sentences.zh: 现在，有一些更新的舵机可以通过例如 I2C 或其他协议进行通信，这是另一种协议，所以它不必是特定的。

sentences.en: But you just kind of got to know.
sentences.zh: 但你只需要了解这一点。

sentences.en: And other people are out there doing this stuff.
sentences.zh: 而且其他人也都在做这些事情。

sentences.en: And you can buy servos really cheap online.
sentences.zh: 你可以在网上买到非常便宜的舵机。

sentences.en: Like, we're talking like $1, $2, $3, $4, $5.
sentences.zh: 比如，我们说的是 1 美元、2 美元、3 美元、4 美元、5 美元。

sentences.en: You know, I see a lot of servos for $5.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我看到很多 5 美元的舵机。

sentences.en: They're not great servos, but you can make a move and do little things.
sentences.zh: 它们虽然不是什么好舵机，但你可以让它们动起来并做一些小事情。

sentences.en: And, yeah, so a lot of times you can find sample code to do it.
sentences.zh: 而且，是的，所以很多时候你可以找到用来实现这一功能的示例代码。

sentences.en: I don't know if the MSP430 has, but a lot of the DSP chips have a library set up to do pulse width modulation,
sentences.zh: 我不知道 MSP430 上有没有，但许多 DSP 芯片都设置好了用于脉冲宽度调制的库，

sentences.en: where you basically just say, my cycle length is this time and my current pulse width should be this.
sentences.zh: 你基本上只需说，我的周期长度是这个时间，我的当前脉冲宽度应该是这个。

sentences.en: And then it handles all the rest of it for you.
sentences.zh: 然后它会为你处理其余的所有事情。

sentences.en: Oh, so it's got its own, like, while true kind of thing going on there.
sentences.zh: 哦，所以它有它自己的那种类似 while true 的运行机制。

sentences.en: And it's in hardware so that you don't have to waste CPU cycles sitting there.
sentences.zh: 而且它是用硬件实现的，这样你就不用浪费 CPU 周期坐在那里干等了。

sentences.en: Because if it was using a CPU, you kind of spent a lot of time trying to sit there managing, making sure it's right.
sentences.zh: 因为如果它使用 CPU，你会花很多时间坐在那里管理，确保它是正确的。

sentences.en: This way you can kind of tell the hardware, go do this.
sentences.zh: 通过这种方式，你可以告诉硬件去执行这个任务。

sentences.en: And then it just sits there and does it for you.
sentences.zh: 然后它就坐在那里为你完成工作。

sentences.en: Cool, that's awesome.
sentences.zh: 酷，这太棒了。

sentences.en: Yeah, I want to make, I want to just get started making really simple things,
sentences.zh: 是的，我想制作，我只想开始制作非常简单的东西，

sentences.en: like something that would, like, unscrew a bottle, you know, bottle cap or something like that, and get started.
sentences.zh: 比如能把瓶子拧开的东西，你知道的，瓶盖或者类似的东西，以此来开始。

sentences.en: So maybe I'll pick up one of these launch pads.
sentences.zh: 所以也许我会去买一个这样的启动板。

sentences.en: Yeah, so launch pad is my tool of the bi-week.
sentences.zh: 对，所以启动板就是我双周推荐的工具。

sentences.en: And yours?
sentences.zh: 你的呢？

sentences.en: Nice, so my tool of the bi-week is along a similar line, along the lines of getting into hardware.
sentences.zh: 太棒了，所以我的双周工具沿着类似的路线，也就是涉足硬件开发的路线。

sentences.en: And so the tool is SketchUp, Google SketchUp, which SketchUp by itself is just a 3D modeling tool, but it doesn't do texturing.
sentences.zh: 所以这个工具就是 SketchUp，谷歌 SketchUp，SketchUp 本身只是一个 3D 建模工具，但它不做材质贴图。

sentences.en: And it's not focused on texturing, as most tools are, and on authoring, you know, 3D content for, you know, video games or for movies.
sentences.zh: 而且它不专注于材质贴图，不像大多数工具那样，也不专注于为电子游戏或电影创作，你知道的，3D 内容。

sentences.en: SketchUp is about drafting, and it's about sort of designing something at a high level.
sentences.zh: SketchUp 关乎草图绘制，关乎从宏观层面设计一些东西。

sentences.en: So that's why if you see SketchUp, you know, models, they'll often look very flat.
sentences.zh: 所以这就是为什么如果你看到 SketchUp，你知道的，模型，它们通常看起来非常平坦。

sentences.en: And that's because what you're seeing is, what's the focus is really on the geometry of the model, and not so much on how it actually looks.
sentences.zh: 那是因为你所看到的，重点其实在于模型的几何形状，而不是它实际看起来怎么样。

sentences.en: You're not going to find a ray tracer, you're not going to find, like, lighting and mirrors
sentences.zh: 你在那里找不到光线追踪器，你也找不到类似灯光和镜子之类的东西，

sentences.en: and all these fancy things that you might in Render Man, which makes, you know, Shrek in those movies.
sentences.zh: 以及所有那些你在 RenderMan（曾制作过《怪物史瑞克》等电影）中可能会看到的各种花哨东西。

sentences.en: But if you want to just rapidly prototype, it has an extremely slick user interface.
sentences.zh: 但如果你想快速制作原型，它的用户界面极其流畅。

sentences.en: And it knows that because it's a design tool that the geometry is not going to be very complex.
sentences.zh: 而且它很清楚，因为这是一个设计工具，所以几何形状不会非常复杂。

sentences.en: You're not going to try to model someone's face in SketchUp, you know.
sentences.zh: 你不会试图在 SketchUp 里给别人的脸建模，你知道的。

sentences.en: So it lets you, like, mess with the different vertices and different geometry at a low level, knowing that you're not going to be dealing with millions of these objects.
sentences.zh: 所以它让你在底层处理不同的顶点和不同的几何形状，它知道你不会去处理数百万个这样的对象。

sentences.en: And because of that, it gives you a lot of flexibility.
sentences.zh: 正因如此，它赋予了你极大的灵活性。

sentences.en: So SketchUp actually integrates with something called the Thingamatic, which is done by MakerBot.
sentences.zh: 所以 SketchUp 实际上与一个叫做 Thingamatic 的东西集成了，这是由 MakerBot 制作的。

sentences.en: And you can buy this Thingamatic kit, and it'll actually work in tandem with SketchUp to produce 3D, I guess, lithographs.
sentences.zh: 你可以买这个 Thingamatic 套件，它实际上会与 SketchUp 协同工作来制作 3D，我猜，光刻模型。

sentences.en: Is that the right word?
sentences.zh: 是这个词吗？

sentences.en: Printed.
sentences.zh: 打印出来的模型。

sentences.en: Yeah, basically 3D, like, real 3D models.
sentences.zh: 对，基本上是 3D 的，就像真正的 3D 模型一样。

sentences.en: Yeah, it extrudes little bits of plastic.
sentences.zh: 对，它会挤出小块的塑料。

sentences.en: Yeah, so you can, in SketchUp, you can make a model of, you know, a sphere or try and, like, grow your, you know,
sentences.zh: 对，所以你可以在 SketchUp 中制作一个模型，你知道的，一个球体，或者尝试，像这样，发展你的，你知道的，

sentences.en: make a, design a model of your hand or a model of a little spaceship.
sentences.zh: 制作一个，设计一个你手部的模型或一个小飞船的模型。

sentences.en: And you can export your SketchUp model to MakerBot, and it will actually construct it in 3D out of a plastic resin.
sentences.zh: 你可以把你的 SketchUp 模型导出到 MakerBot，它就会用塑料树脂在 3D 中实际构建出它。

sentences.en: Yeah, so I wasn't paying attention that this was your tool of the week.
sentences.zh: 是的，所以我刚才没注意到这是你本周推荐的工具。

sentences.en: So when earlier I was talking about the RepRap, that this is kind of the same idea.
sentences.zh: 所以我刚才在谈论 RepRap 时，这其实是同一个概念。

sentences.en: RepRap is similar to the MakerBot.
sentences.zh: RepRap 类似于 MakerBot。

sentences.en: It's the, not the open source version of the MakerBot, but an earlier version of the MakerBot, something that...
sentences.zh: 它不是 MakerBot 的开源版本，而是 MakerBot 的早期版本，某种...

sentences.en: How do you spell it?
sentences.zh: 这个怎么拼？

sentences.en: RepRap.
sentences.zh: RepRap。

sentences.en: R-E-P-R-A-P.
sentences.zh: R-E-P-R-A-P.

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: And so this is one that is, you know, with kind of the intention of bootstrapping itself that I was talking about.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个，你知道的，带有我刚才提到的那种自我启动意图的项目。

sentences.en: It does kind of something similar to the MakerBot, though, where it prints things out of what, I guess it's rods of plastic, plastic string,
sentences.zh: 它做的事情和 MakerBot 类似，它用的是什么来打印东西呢，我猜是塑料棒、塑料丝，

sentences.en: goes into a little extruder, and it puts little dots at a single layer.
sentences.zh: 进入一个小挤出机，然后在单层上放置小点。

sentences.en: Then it moves the platform down or moves the extruder up and then places another set of little dots.
sentences.zh: 然后它把平台往下移或把挤出机往上移，接着放置另一组小点。

sentences.en: And slowly, you know, layer by layer, it builds up.
sentences.zh: 然后慢慢地，你知道的，一层一层地构建起来。

sentences.en: So kind of like an inkjet printer.
sentences.zh: 所以有点像喷墨打印机。

sentences.en: But instead of, you know, the paper moving out, the head moves around, and then the platform and head separate, and then it prints again, slowly building up the structure.
sentences.zh: 但不同于，你知道的，纸张移出，而是打印头四处移动，然后平台和打印头分离，接着再次打印，慢慢构建出结构。

sentences.en: Nice.
sentences.zh: 真棒。

sentences.en: So interesting, I don't know if you've seen this before, but the Thingomatic is a 3D printer.
sentences.zh: 太有趣了，我不知道你以前有没有见过这个，但 Thingomatic 是一台 3D 打印机。

sentences.en: And then the Thingiverse, which is thingiverse.com, is a collection of 3D models, a lot of which have been done in Google SketchUp.
sentences.zh: 然后 Thingiverse，也就是 thingiverse.com，是一个 3D 模型库，其中许多都是在 Google SketchUp 中制作的。

sentences.en: And people put these things up here, open source, you know, a repository of them, and then they have it so you can print it with your MakerBot or with your RepRap
sentences.zh: 人们把这些东西放到这里，开源的，你知道的，一个它们的资源库，然后你可以用你的 MakerBot 或 RepRap 把它打印出来，

sentences.en: or sometimes with a laser cutter and make these things that other people have made and make them yourself so the idea that, you know, one day in the future, I want a coffee mug.
sentences.zh: 或者有时用激光切割机把别人做好的这些东西做出来，自己动手做，所以这个想法是，你知道的，未来某天，我想要一个咖啡杯。

sentences.en: I don't have a coffee mug.
sentences.zh: 我没有咖啡杯。

sentences.en: You just go over to your printer and you go to, you know, Amazon.com or maybe you go to one of these Thingiverse, a free one,
sentences.zh: 你只需走到你的打印机前，访问，你知道的，Amazon.com 或者也许你访问这些 Thingiverse 网站之一，一个免费的网站，

sentences.en: and you download a free coffee mug and then it just prints it on your printer and then five minutes later you come and there's your coffee mug ready to use.
sentences.zh: 然后你下载一个免费的咖啡杯，它就会直接在你的打印机上打印出来，五分钟后你走过去，你的咖啡杯就准备好可以使用了。

sentences.en: Yeah, I think this is a really exciting time for us, you know, computer nerds because, you know, for example, I wanted to make a PDA that was completely open source.
sentences.zh: 是的，我认为对我们这些电脑极客来说，这是一个非常令人兴奋的时代，你知道的，因为，举个例子，我想制作一个完全开源的 PDA。

sentences.en: And it was a really big pain.
sentences.zh: 这真是一件非常令人头疼的事。

sentences.en: You know, I had to get the circuit board.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我必须弄到电路板。

sentences.en: I had to get a little LCD display.
sentences.zh: 我必须弄到一个小液晶显示屏。

sentences.en: I had to make those two talk to each other.
sentences.zh: 我必须让这两者互相通信。

sentences.en: I had to write my own driver for the LCD display.
sentences.zh: 我必须为液晶显示屏编写我自己的驱动程序。

sentences.en: You know, I had to get a version of Linux, blah, blah, blah, so on and so forth.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，我必须弄到一个 Linux 版本，等等等等，诸如此类。

sentences.en: But then once I had done all that, you know, software engineering work, I ended up using Lego.
sentences.zh: 但一旦我完成了所有这些，你知道的，软件工程工作，我最终使用的是乐高。

sentences.en: I had to build a case for my PDA.
sentences.zh: 我不得不为我的 PDA 搭建一个外壳。

sentences.en: And not knowing anything about hardware or woodworking or anything at the time, I used Lego and made this giant PDA that barely fits in my pocket
sentences.zh: 当时我对硬件、木工什么的完全一无所知，于是我用乐高拼了这个巨大的PDA，勉强能塞进口袋里

sentences.en: but plays Dwarf Fortress out of Lego.
sentences.zh: 但它居然能用乐高玩《矮人要塞》。

sentences.en: Lego and gumsticks board and LCD.
sentences.zh: 乐高加上口香糖棍尺寸的电路板和液晶屏。

sentences.en: But now the technology has come so far that for, you know, it's still a little expensive.
sentences.zh: 但现在技术已经发展到这个地步，你知道的，虽然还是有点贵。

sentences.en: The Thingamatic is $1,300 and the other one is the RepRap is, what, around $800?
sentences.zh: Thingamatic 要 1300 美元，另一个 RepRap 大概是多少，800 美元左右吧？

sentences.en: Yeah, I mean, it just depends on what level of kit you get.
sentences.zh: 对啊，我的意思是，这完全取决于你买的是哪个级别的套件。

sentences.en: But I think, yeah, all up, once you pay for everything, it's going to be about that.
sentences.zh: 不过我想，对，总算下来，一旦你把所有东西都买齐，差不多就是这个价。

sentences.en: But, yeah, for about, you know, $1,500, you could have something which constructs the shell of whatever you want.
sentences.zh: 但是，对，大概只要花个 1500 美元左右，你就能搞到一台能打印出你想要的任何外壳的设备。

sentences.en: The electrical component, you can get that for $4, as Patrick showed.
sentences.zh: 至于电子元件，正如帕特里克所展示的那样，4 美元就能买到。

sentences.en: And the different servos and motors and sensors that make up, you know, that part of your design.
sentences.zh: 还有构成你设计那部分所需的各种伺服电机、马达和传感器。

sentences.en: But we're in a position where you can prototype just about anything as a hobbyiSt.
sentences.zh: 但我们现在处于这样一个阶段，作为一个爱好者，你几乎可以对任何东西进行原型设计。

sentences.en: I mean, if you need it to be stainless steel and you do arc welding, well, you might still be out of luck.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，如果你需要不锈钢材质而且还要做电弧焊，好吧，那可能还是有点难办。

sentences.en: But, you know, you could do just about anything nowadays, and I think that's really exciting.
sentences.zh: 不过，你知道的，现在你几乎可以做任何事情，我觉得这真的让人很兴奋。

sentences.en: Yeah, and I've tried my hand at things like SketchUp and others and found I'm pretty terrible at it.
sentences.zh: 对，我也尝试过 SketchUp 之类的一些软件，结果发现自己在这方面简直糟透了。

sentences.en: Yeah, me too.
sentences.zh: 对，我也是。

sentences.en: But what's cool is some of the people doing this printing are writing computer programs to make the files to print.
sentences.zh: 但酷炫的是，有些人在做这种打印时，会编写计算机程序来生成用于打印的文件。

sentences.en: So I saw one guy the other day ran Conway's Game of Life and let it play out over a whole bunch of iterations
sentences.zh: 所以我前几天看到有个家伙运行了康威生命游戏，让它在大量迭代中不断演化

sentences.en: and then kind of kept a history of everywhere where it went and printed out a 3D model of, like, a representation of a run of Game of Life.
sentences.zh: 然后记录下它走过的每一个地方的历史，并打印出一个 3D 模型，就像是对生命游戏运行过程的一种具象呈现。

sentences.en: Nice.
sentences.zh: 不错。

sentences.en: And that was kind of cool.
sentences.zh: 这确实挺酷的。

sentences.en: Or, you know, procedurally generating a 3D model and then printing that out.
sentences.zh: 或者说，通过程序生成一个 3D 模型，然后再把它打印出来。

sentences.en: So, you know, like a fractal generator or like a, what is it,
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，就像分形生成器，或者像那个，叫什么来着，

sentences.en: Sarah Pitsky's gasket, right, in 3D, and then printing that out.
sentences.zh: 萨拉·皮茨基垫圈，对吧，做成 3D 的，然后把它打印出来。

sentences.en: So if you're really nerdy but are terrible at drawing stuff and making stuff on SketchUp, then you can write programs to make the models that then your printer can print.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你是个十足的极客，但又不擅长画画和用 SketchUp 制作东西，那么你可以编写程序来制作模型，然后让你的打印机把它打印出来。

sentences.en: Yeah, and Patrick made another good point earlier, which is, you know, both SketchUp and MakerBot and probably the RepRap, too, have a library of existing models.
sentences.zh: 对，帕特里克刚才还提到了另一个很好的观点，那就是，你知道的，无论是 SketchUp、MakerBot，还是可能还有 RepRap，都有一个现有模型的库。

sentences.en: In fact, SketchUp has a massive, massive database and you can get everything from buildings, famous buildings, you know, completely modeled in SketchUp,
sentences.zh: 事实上，SketchUp 有一个庞大无比的数据库，你可以找到各种各样的东西，从建筑、著名的建筑，你知道的，完全在 SketchUp 中建模的建筑，

sentences.en: all the way down to, like, you know, a model of a hand.
sentences.zh: 一直到，比如说，你知道的，一只手的模型。

sentences.en: You can get different, like, I don't know, tools.
sentences.zh: 你可以找到各种各样的，比如说，我不知道，各种工具。

sentences.en: You can get those scissors that, you know, you can download just the model instead of having to make it yourself.
sentences.zh: 你可以找到那种剪刀，你知道的，你只需要下载模型就行了，而不用自己去制作。

sentences.en: Can I print a house to live in?
sentences.zh: 我能打印一栋房子来住吗？

sentences.en: Maybe.
sentences.zh: 也许吧。

sentences.en: I don't think you could print a duplicate of your house, though, because your house has the printer in it, and you would have to print the printer.
sentences.zh: 不过我觉得你不可能打印出你房子的复制品，因为你的房子里面就放着打印机，你还得把打印机也打印出来。

sentences.en: So if I made a model of my house, I think this was an XKCD comic.
sentences.zh: 所以如果我做了一个我房子的模型，我觉得这好像是 XKCD 漫画里的梗。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Uh-oh.
sentences.zh: 噢哦。

sentences.en: The model would have to be in the model.
sentences.zh: 那个模型里还得包含这个模型本身。

sentences.en: Would you have to be in the model?
sentences.zh: 那你也得呆在模型里面吗？

sentences.en: No!
sentences.zh: 才不呢！

sentences.en: Uh-oh.
sentences.zh: 噢哦。

sentences.en: So don't model perfectly every detail of your house.
sentences.zh: 所以千万别把你的房子的每一个细节都完美建模。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And then try to print it.
sentences.zh: 然后还试图去打印它。

sentences.en: Yeah, that would fail.
sentences.zh: 对，那样肯定会失败。

sentences.en: Or model it.
sentences.zh: 或者干脆给它建模。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's a bad idea.
sentences.zh: 对，这绝对是个馊主意。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So I'm going to give a shameless plug here to Endless Forms, which is close enough to what we were talking about.
sentences.zh: 所以我要在这里厚着脸皮宣传一下 Endless Forms，它和我们刚才讨论的内容相当契合。

sentences.en: But EndlessForMs.com is a website that's run from a couple of colleagues of mine out of Cornell.
sentences.zh: 但 EndlessForms.com 是一个网站，由我在康奈尔大学的几个同事运营。

sentences.en: And this is an evolutionary computation program for generating three-dimensional art.
sentences.zh: 这是一个用于生成三维艺术的演化计算程序。

sentences.en: So I don't really know how to describe this, but basically you start on there, and it just has these random geometries of different circles and patterns,
sentences.zh: 所以我其实不知道该怎么形容这个，但基本上你一上去，它就会展示这些由不同圆圈和图案组成的随机几何图形，

sentences.en: and you can kind of see what they look like in 3D.
sentences.zh: 你可以大致看到它们在 3D 状态下的样子。

sentences.en: And then you kind of, you have, you pick from this population.
sentences.zh: 然后你就可以，从这个群体中进行挑选。

sentences.en: Like, oh, I like this.
sentences.zh: 比如，哦，我喜欢这个。

sentences.en: Okay, so I'm here now, and I see one that says Mushroom.
sentences.zh: 行吧，我现在到了这里，看到一个写着“蘑菇”的东西。

sentences.en: So what do I do?
sentences.zh: 那我该怎么做？

sentences.en: So what you're looking at when you go on Endless Forms are, these are the top-rated forms that other people have made.
sentences.zh: 所以你访问 Endless Forms 时看到的内容，其实是其他人制作的获最高评价的形态。

sentences.en: So they've evolved them, or they've made them?
sentences.zh: 所以这些是他们演化出来的，还是他们自己做的？

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So you click on Start Anew.
sentences.zh: 所以你点击“从头开始”（Start Anew）。

sentences.en: It's going to give you a set of individuals.
sentences.zh: 它会给你一组个体。

sentences.en: You pick some parents, and you can mate them and see what their baby would look like.
sentences.zh: 你挑选一些父代，然后让它们进行交配，看看它们的“孩子”会是什么样子。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有点意思。

sentences.en: Oh, okay.
sentences.zh: 哦，好吧。

sentences.en: So these are just giving me a bunch of random ones.
sentences.zh: 所以这些只是给我提供了一堆随机的形态。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: And so the hope is that, in the same way as, you know, the fast lion catches the prey and natural evolution, survival of the fittest propagates, in the same way, you know,
sentences.zh: 所以人们希望，就像自然演化中奔跑最快的狮子捕获猎物、适者生存得以繁衍一样，同样地，你知道的，

sentences.en: the shapes that you find the most pleasing or the most amiable for this session will start to propagate, and you'll end up, you know, with your own species of 3D shapes.
sentences.zh: 在这次体验中你觉得最顺眼或最讨喜的形状将会开始繁衍，最终，你知道的，你会拥有属于你自己的 3D 形状物种。

sentences.en: So these guys are going to be at the Gecko Conference this year showing off their forMs.
sentences.zh: 所以这帮家伙今年会去参加吉尔科（Gecko）会议，展示他们的形态。

sentences.en: So if you have some time, go to endlessforMs.com and generate some cool things, and they will add them to the display section at the conference.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你有时间，去 endlessforms.com 生成一些酷炫的东西吧，他们会把它们添加到会议的展示区里。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有意思。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Although it's kind of interesting that all the popular ones are ones that resemble real-life objects.
sentences.zh: 不过挺有意思的是，所有受欢迎的形态居然都是那些酷似现实生活中的物体的形状。

sentences.en: Yeah, it is.
sentences.zh: 对，确实是。

sentences.en: It's sort of...
sentences.zh: 这有点……

sentences.en: As opposed to things that are...
sentences.zh: 而不是那些……

sentences.en: You know, you would have thought people would have been interested in things that are like, oh, that's clever, but new or different.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，你本来会以为人们会对那种“哇，这太聪明了，但又很新颖或很独特”的东西感兴趣。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah.
sentences.zh: 对，对。

sentences.en: It's surprising that, you know, I think people are, at this point, since it's so early, people are just happy that it can generate things that look like other things.
sentences.zh: 令人惊讶的是，你知道的，我觉得大家在这个阶段，由于技术还处于早期，只要它能生成看起来像其他东西的形状，人们就已经很开心了。

sentences.en: Well, cool.
sentences.zh: 好吧，挺酷的。

sentences.en: That's cool.
sentences.zh: 这很酷。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 行吧。

sentences.en: And, you know, you could, in theory, if they give you the model, which I think they do, you can import that into SketchUp and then export that into the thing-o-matic format
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道的，理论上，如果他们给你模型——我想他们会的——你可以把它导入 SketchUp，然后导出为 Thing-o-Matic 格式

sentences.en: and then print it on a 3D printer.
sentences.zh: 接着在 3D 打印机上把它打印出来。

sentences.en: Ooh, that's cool.
sentences.zh: 噢，那太酷了。

sentences.en: Yeah, good stuff.
sentences.zh: 对，好东西。

sentences.en: You better be careful, because if you print something sentient, we could all be in trouble.
sentences.zh: 你最好小心点，因为如果你打印出什么有意识的东西，我们大家可能都有麻烦了。

sentences.en: Yeah, bad news.
sentences.zh: 对，坏消息。

sentences.en: Bad news.
sentences.zh: 坏消息。

sentences.en: Or if you print a Klein bottle, it might just be stuck in an infinite loop.
sentences.zh: 或者如果你打印了一个克莱因瓶，它可能就会直接陷入无限循环。

sentences.en: Oh, no.
sentences.zh: 噢，不。

sentences.en: That would be terrible.
sentences.zh: 那可太糟糕了。

sentences.en: Cool.
sentences.zh: 酷。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 行吧。

sentences.en: So I think that ties us up for our tools of the bi-week.
sentences.zh: 我想这就是我们这双周工具环节的全部内容了。

sentences.en: Cool.
sentences.zh: 酷。

sentences.en: So I think we're going to be talking about MATLAB slash Octave this week.
sentences.zh: 所以我们这周要讨论的是 MATLAB 还有 Octave。

sentences.en: So why don't we start off talking about MATLAB?
sentences.zh: 那我们为什么不从讨论 MATLAB 开始呢？

sentences.en: Since that's the first of our pair here, what does MATLAB stand for?
sentences.zh: 既然这是我们这对组合里的第一个，MATLAB 是什么意思？

sentences.en: Yeah, so MATLAB stands for Matrix Laboratory.
sentences.zh: 对，所以 MATLAB 代表 Matrix Laboratory（矩阵实验室）。

sentences.en: And so MATLAB is an interpreted language, and it's meant to be sort of a laboratory or a playground for nerds like us to sort of go in and do matrix operations.
sentences.zh: 因此 MATLAB 是一种解释型语言，它旨在成为像我们这样的极客进入并进行矩阵运算的一种实验室或游乐场。

sentences.en: So a lot of linear algebra, a lot of analysis of data, which is quite often stored in matrices.
sentences.zh: 所以其中涉及大量的线性代数，以及对通常存储在矩阵中的数据进行的大量分析。

sentences.en: If you've ever used Excel, you know, an Excel has a grid of cells, and a matrix also is a 2D grid of cells.
sentences.zh: 如果你用过 Excel，你知道的，Excel 有一个单元格网格，而矩阵同样也是一个二维的单元格网格。

sentences.en: So if you've ever used Excel, you've worked with something sort of analogous to a matrix.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你用过 Excel，你其实就已经使用过某种类似于矩阵的东西了。

sentences.en: And it turns out that matrices are just very popular and almost ubiquitous in mathematics.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，矩阵在数学中非常受欢迎，几乎无处不在。

sentences.en: And so this is sort of a place where you can go in and try different functions and do analysis at a high level.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个你可以进去尝试不同函数并进行高水平分析的地方。

sentences.en: So MATLAB refers both to the language and to the product?
sentences.zh: 所以 MATLAB 既指语言，也指产品？

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, you know, the scripting language that comes with MATLAB shares its name.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，MATLAB 自带的脚本语言也共用了这个名字。

sentences.en: And so often it can be a little bit confusing because you could say I'm talking about MATLAB, but you're talking about the code.
sentences.zh: 因此这通常会让人有点困惑，因为你可能会说你在谈论 MATLAB，但其实你指的是代码。

sentences.en: Or you could say I'm talking about MATLAB, the product.
sentences.zh: 或者你可以说你在谈论 MATLAB 这个产品。

sentences.en: Oh, okay.
sentences.zh: 哦，原来如此。

sentences.en: So people use this?
sentences.zh: 所以大家都在用这个？

sentences.en: It's pretty popular?
sentences.zh: 它挺受欢迎的吗？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So MATLAB is hugely popular, especially in the, you know, especially in the market of people who are sort of analyzing data.
sentences.zh: 所以 MATLAB 非常受欢迎，特别是在分析数据的群体中。

sentences.en: So linear control systems, guys who are doing, you know, servos, as Patrick was talking about earlier, and trying to create systems, and robotics tend to use a lot of MATLAB.
sentences.zh: 比如线性控制系统，搞伺服电机的人——正如帕特里克刚才所说的那样——他们试图创建系统时，还有机器人技术，往往会使用大量的 MATLAB。

sentences.en: People who are analyzing data, trying to generate statistics and regression and things like that are definitely using MATLAB.
sentences.zh: 那些分析数据、试图生成统计数据、回归分析以及诸如此类东西的人绝对都在使用 MATLAB。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有意思。

sentences.en: It's also really popular in school.
sentences.zh: 它在学校里也非常受欢迎。

sentences.en: I remember in university that everybody seemed to be using it.
sentences.zh: 我记得在大学里，好像每个人都在用它。

sentences.en: All the professors, at some point, just like all of a sudden, all the professors assumed you knew MATLAB.
sentences.zh: 所有的教授，在某个时间点，就像是突然之间，所有的教授都默认你懂 MATLAB。

sentences.en: And I was like, no, wait, what?
sentences.zh: 当时我的反应是：等等，什么？

sentences.en: MATLAB?
sentences.zh: MATLAB？

sentences.en: What's that?
sentences.zh: 那是什么？

sentences.en: Yeah, I got burned by that too.
sentences.zh: 对，我也被这事坑过。

sentences.en: I went into image processing.
sentences.zh: 我当时修图像处理。

sentences.en: It was a master's class.
sentences.zh: 那是一门硕士课程。

sentences.en: And, yeah, he said that everyone will program their assignments in MATLAB.
sentences.zh: 然后，对，他说每个人都要用 MATLAB 来编写作业程序。

sentences.en: And I'd never seen MATLAB before.
sentences.zh: 而我以前从来没见过 MATLAB。

sentences.en: And, yeah, everyone has to kind of go through those moments.
sentences.zh: 然后，对，每个人都得经历那些时刻。

sentences.en: You know, in our case, it was MATLAB.
sentences.zh: 你知道的，对我们来说，那次是 MATLAB。

sentences.en: Maybe some other people had the same situation with C.
sentences.zh: 也许其他人对 C 语言也有过同样的遭遇。

sentences.en: But everyone goes to that moment where it's like, you know, you walk into either a job or a classroom,
sentences.zh: 但每个人都会经历那种时刻，就是，你知道的，你走进一家公司或者一间教室，

sentences.en: and someone says, everyone's doing everything in blah, MATLAB, Erlang, whatever.
sentences.zh: 然后有人说，大家所有的东西都用某某语言、MATLAB、Erlang 或者别的什么来做。

sentences.zh: MATLAB 是静态类型还是动态类型的？
