sentences.en: So static versus dynamic typing.
sentences.zh: 那么，静态类型与动态类型。

sentences.en: Well, let's try to give it short and sweet.
sentences.zh: 好，我们尽量长话短说，简单明了。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Because we could go on a long time about this.
sentences.zh: 因为我们可以聊这个聊很久。

sentences.en: And there's all sorts of variations in between and all sorts of which one's better than the other.
sentences.zh: 这中间有各种各样的变体，还有各种关于哪个更好的讨论。

sentences.en: And as I think our stand is on this podcast, we're all about right tool for the right problem, you know, expanding your toolbox so you'll be able to solve the problem with
sentences.zh: 正如我们在这个播客中一贯的立场，我们认为关键在于用对的工具解决对的问题，你知道的，拓展你的工具箱，这样你就能用

sentences.en: the best tool possible.
sentences.zh: 最好的工具来解决问题。

sentences.en: And I think dynamic and static typing fall into that, something that is appropriate for different situations.
sentences.zh: 我觉得动态类型和静态类型也属于这一类，它们分别适用于不同的情况。

sentences.en: So dynamic typing, and correct me if I'm wrong, basically means the first time that you have a variable.
sentences.zh: 所以动态类型，如果我没说错的话，基本上意味着你第一次使用某个变量的时候。

sentences.en: So I have the variable letter X.
sentences.zh: 假设我有一个变量 X。

sentences.en: And I say X equals 3.
sentences.zh: 然后我说 X 等于 3。

sentences.en: The compiler, or the thing that has to run the program, if I don't tell it what X is, has to look and say, oh, you're sticking the number 3 in X.
sentences.zh: 编译器，或者说运行程序的那个东西，如果我不告诉它 X 是什么，就必须去查看并判断，哦，你把数字 3 赋给 X 了。

sentences.en: That must be, and then at runtime, dynamically has to decide, oh, that must be an integer.
sentences.zh: 那它一定……然后在运行时，动态地决定，哦，那一定是个整数。

sentences.en: Or if I said 3.1, it has to say, that's a float or a double.
sentences.zh: 或者如果我说 3.1，它就得说，那是一个单精度浮点数或双精度浮点数。

sentences.en: And then later, being dynamic makes the thing that's running at the interpreter have to work a little harder.
sentences.zh: 而且接下来，作为动态类型，会让运行解释器的那个组件稍微多做一点工作。

sentences.en: But then later, it allows me to do things like, then I could set X equal to the string hello world.
sentences.zh: 但随后，它允许我做一些事情，比如我可以把 X 设为字符串“hello world”。

sentences.en: And it can change it for me and say, oh, look, now X is a string.
sentences.zh: 并且它能为我改变类型，并说，看，现在 X 是一个字符串了。

sentences.en: And X doesn't even have to really be a string, as long as if it knows what's stored there and what currently is there.
sentences.zh: 而且 X 甚至不需要真的是某种固定类型，只要它知道那里存储的是什么以及当前是什么就行。

sentences.en: Versus static means, and this is something that's common to like C and Java and C++, means you
sentences.zh: 相比之下，静态类型意味着——这在 C、Java 和 C++ 等语言中很常见——你

sentences.en: have to actually say what type of variable is when you declare it the first time you kind of use it.
sentences.zh: 必须在第一次声明并使用变量时，明确指出它的变量类型。

sentences.en: And so instead of just saying X equals 3, I need to say int X equals 3.
sentences.zh: 所以，不只是简单地说 X 等于 3，我需要写 int X 等于 3。

sentences.en: And telling the compiler, the interpreter, this variable is, shall be, and shall remain an integer.
sentences.zh: 并告诉编译器或解释器：这个变量是、将是、并且也将一直是一个整数。

sentences.en: And that gives it some opportunity to do enhancements, but means that later on, I can't decide, oh, I want to reuse X in the same scope and make it a string now.
sentences.zh: 这给它提供了一些进行优化的机会，但意味着在后面，我不能突然决定说，哦，我想在同一个作用域里重用 X 并把它变成一个字符串。

sentences.en: Because I go, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa, whoa.
sentences.zh: 因为编译器会说：等等、等等、等等、等等、等等、等等、等等。

sentences.en: You told me that was an int.
sentences.zh: 你刚才告诉我是个整型的。

sentences.en: Can't make it a string now, buddy.
sentences.zh: 现在可不能把它变成字符串，老兄。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Yeah, so one of the things about dynamic typing is that it can create a lot of runtime errors
sentences.zh: 对，所以动态类型的一个特点是它会产生很多运行时错误，

sentences.en: because you can do things that you didn't expect, things that would be caught at compile time.
sentences.zh: 因为你会做一些意想不到的事情，而这些事情本来在编译时是可以被捕获的。

sentences.en: So for example, going on to what Patrick was saying, if you say, let's say later on in your code, you have Z equals X plus Y.
sentences.zh: 所以，举个例子，顺着帕特里克刚才的话说，如果你在代码的后面写了 Z 等于 X 加 Y。

sentences.en: If X is 3 and Y is 4, then that's fine.
sentences.zh: 如果 X 是 3，Y 是 4，那没问题。

sentences.en: It can do that addition.
sentences.zh: 它可以执行这个加法。

sentences.en: But if in between there you say X equals hello world, and then you try and add hello world and 4, that's going to cause a runtime error.
sentences.zh: 但如果在这两者之间你写了 X 等于“hello world”，然后你又尝试把“hello world”和 4 相加，那就会导致运行时错误。

sentences.en: Now, you know, in a language with static typing, it knows before it even runs the code that X is a string or an integer.
sentences.zh: 现在，你知道的，在静态类型语言中，甚至在运行代码之前，它就知道 X 是字符串还是整数。

sentences.en: And so it knows that when you've done X plus Y, that that combination is not valid.
sentences.zh: 所以它知道当你执行 X 加 Y 时，这种组合是无效的。

sentences.en: You can't add hello world and 4.
sentences.zh: 你不能把“hello world”和 4 相加。

sentences.en: It doesn't make sense.
sentences.zh: 这说不通。

sentences.en: So a dynamically typed language gives you more freedom, but at the same time allows you to make a mistake at runtime, which can crash your program.
sentences.zh: 所以动态类型语言给了你更多自由，但同时也允许你在运行时犯错，这可能会让你的程序崩溃。

sentences.en: Oh, okay.
sentences.zh: 哦，好吧。

sentences.en: Interesting.
sentences.zh: 有意思。

sentences.en: So back to the original question, MATLAB, having done a little bit of it, I think it's dynamic.
sentences.zh: 所以回到最初的问题，MATLAB，我用过一点，我觉得它是动态类型的。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And MATLAB is definitely dynamically typed.
sentences.zh: 而且 MATLAB 绝对是动态类型的。

sentences.en: Because I've definitely said, you know, A equals X transpose and not had to tell it what it was.
sentences.zh: 因为我绝对写过诸如 A 等于 X 的转置之类的话，而不需要告诉它这是个什么东西。

sentences.en: In fact, I don't even know what it was.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我甚至不知道它原来是什么。

sentences.en: Some matrix, I don't even know what the type was.
sentences.zh: 某个矩阵，我甚至不知道它的具体类型是什么。

sentences.en: So it must be dynamic.
sentences.zh: 所以它一定是动态的。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Yeah, definitely.
sentences.zh: 是的，绝对的。

sentences.en: MATLAB is dynamically typed.
sentences.zh: MATLAB 是动态类型的。

sentences.en: And that gets to a topic that's a little interesting on virtual machine latency.
sentences.zh: 这就引出了一个关于虚拟机延迟的有趣话题。

sentences.en: So...
sentences.zh: 所以……

sentences.en: That sounds bad.
sentences.zh: 听起来不太妙。

sentences.en: Yeah, this is sort of the Achilles heel of MATLAB.
sentences.zh: 对，这可以说是 MATLAB 的阿喀琉斯之踵（致命弱点）。

sentences.en: As Patrick was alluding to, this is how we C and C++ and Java guys have jobs still.
sentences.zh: 正如帕特里克刚才暗示的那样，这就是我们这些 C、C++ 和 Java 程序员至今还能保住工作的原因。

sentences.en: And, you know, let's look at dynamic typing, for example.
sentences.zh: 而且，比方说我们来看看动态类型。

sentences.en: MATLAB does X plus Y.
sentences.zh: MATLAB 执行 X 加 Y。

sentences.en: So let's just look at that function.
sentences.zh: 所以我们来看看这个函数。

sentences.en: It has to know what X and Y are.
sentences.zh: 它必须先搞清楚 X 和 Y 分别是什么。

sentences.en: And then based on that, it has to call a different addition.
sentences.zh: 然后根据这一点，它必须调用不同的加法函数。

sentences.en: So if X is an integer, if X is a matrix of integers, and Y is a matrix of integers, it has a certain function that adds those two.
sentences.zh: 所以如果 X 是一个整数，如果 X 是一个整数矩阵，而 Y 也是一个整数矩阵，它就有一个特定的函数来把这两个相加。

sentences.en: If X is a matrix of floating point, X and Y are floating point matrices, it has a different function that operates on floating point.
sentences.zh: 如果 X 是浮点数矩阵，X 和 Y 都是浮点数矩阵，它就有一个不同的函数来处理浮点数。

sentences.en: And so for every instruction that you execute in MATLAB, it has to do a lot of thinking, as opposed to C,
sentences.zh: 所以在 MATLAB 中执行的每一条指令，它都必须进行大量的思考，相比之下，在 C 语言中，

sentences.en: where every instruction corresponds to one or at most a handful of machine code, of assembly code instructions.
sentences.zh: 每一条指令对应着一条或最多一小撮机器码、汇编代码指令。

sentences.en: And the compiler only has to do a lot of thinking still, but it knows a lot, and it only has to do it once.
sentences.zh: 而且编译器虽然也需要做大量思考，但它知道很多信息，并且只需要做一次。

sentences.en: And then it generates an executable, which can run many, many times.
sentences.zh: 然后它会生成一个可执行文件，可以运行非常非常多次。

sentences.en: Right, exactly.
sentences.zh: 对，确实如此。

sentences.en: Exactly.
sentences.zh: 确实如此。

sentences.en: So, you know, in the case of C, for example, or let's look at C++, C++ has a function called find, where you can give it the beginning and the end of an array,
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，以 C 语言为例，或者我们看看 C++，C++ 有一个叫 find 的函数，你可以把数组的开头和结尾传给它，

sentences.en: and a value to look for, and it'll return if it found that value or not.
sentences.zh: 以及要寻找的值，它会返回是否找到了这个值。

sentences.en: That, calling the find function is about the same, will take about the same time as looping through the array yourself and looking for the value.
sentences.zh: 调用这个 find 函数的速度和你自己写循环遍历数组去寻找这个值的时间差不多。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: But in MATLAB, calling the find function is much, much faster than looping through the array and looking for the value.
sentences.zh: 但是在 MATLAB 中，调用 find 函数比循环遍历数组寻找数值要快得多得多。

sentences.en: So if you're looking for 5, and you just call find my matrix comma 5, that will return instantly.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你在找数字 5，直接调用 find(我的矩阵, 5)，它会瞬间返回。

sentences.en: But if you loop through your matrix...
sentences.zh: 但如果你用循环遍历你的矩阵……

sentences.en: Literally instantly?
sentences.zh: 字面意思上的瞬间？

sentences.en: It'll return in nanoseconds.
sentences.zh: 它会在纳秒内返回。

sentences.en: But, or let's say...
sentences.zh: 但是，或者比方说……

sentences.en: A short amount of time.
sentences.zh: 很短的时间内。

sentences.en: A handful of microseconds.
sentences.zh: 短短的几微秒。

sentences.en: But if you do, you know, if you have a gigantic array and you write a for loop in MATLAB that just loops through the array and checks for 5, that will take on the order of seconds.
sentences.zh: 但如果你写了，你知道的，如果你有一个巨大的数组，在 MATLAB 里写了一个 for 循环去遍历数组并检查是不是 5，那就要花上好几秒钟。

sentences.en: So it will take, you know, a million times longer for you to loop through.
sentences.zh: 所以你用循环遍历会慢上整整一百万倍。

sentences.en: And that's because you're executing a million times as many instructions.
sentences.zh: 那是因为你执行了一百万倍数量的指令。

sentences.en: And each instruction has this VM virtual machine latency, has this overhead associated with it.
sentences.zh: 而且每一条指令都有这种虚拟机（VM）延迟，都有这种与之相关的性能开销。

sentences.en: So that's because each time, when you do the find, you just have to look up the applicable function to call once.
sentences.zh: 所以这是因为每一次当你使用 find 时，你只需要查找一次要调用的适用函数。

sentences.en: But when you're looping it over, every time it gets there, it has to try and figure out what it's doing.
sentences.zh: 但当你用循环遍历时，每到一步，它都必须去琢磨自己到底在干什么。

sentences.en: Because it's dynamic, it could have changed.
sentences.zh: 因为它是个动态的，类型随时可能变。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So that, you know, if you're doing it yourself, you loop through the array and you say, you know, does the matrix at this index equal 5?
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，如果你自己动手写，遍历数组然后说，这个索引处的矩阵等于 5 吗？

sentences.en: And the matrix might have changed.
sentences.zh: 而且矩阵可能已经变了。

sentences.en: Like, the variable might not be a matrix anymore.
sentences.zh: 比如，这个变量可能不再是矩阵了。

sentences.en: The matrix index might have changed.
sentences.zh: 矩阵的索引可能已经改变了。

sentences.en: Maybe that's not an int or maybe something weird has happened to that.
sentences.zh: 也许那不再是个整数，或者发生了什么奇怪的事情。

sentences.en: But what it means to index the matrix, it has to, you know, look that up.
sentences.zh: 但要对矩阵进行索引，它必须去查阅这些信息。

sentences.en: Versus in C, the compiler has done all that.
sentences.zh: 相比之下在 C 语言中，编译器已经把这一切都做完了。

sentences.en: And it's just coming down to, is this address equal to 5?
sentences.zh: 它最后归结为：这个地址的值等于 5 吗？

sentences.en: And that's a single instruction on the CPA.
sentences.zh: 这在 CPU 上只是一条单一的指令。

sentences.en: The value is stored at this address equal to 5.
sentences.zh: 存储在这个地址的值等于 5。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, yeah.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的。

sentences.en: So, you know, the VM, the virtual machine overhead in MATLAB is extremely, extremely high.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，MATLAB 中的虚拟机开销非常非常高。

sentences.en: And that's why a lot of things that are prototyped in MATLAB but are meant for, like,
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么很多在 MATLAB 中进行原型设计、但最终要用于生产环境的东西，

sentences.en: a production environment are then recoded in C or C++ or Java or some other language that doesn't have this overhead.
sentences.zh: 后来都会用 C、C++、Java 或其他没有这种开销的语言重新编写。

sentences.en: So, from what you tell me, you know, I'd be kind of bummed about MATLAB.
sentences.zh: 所以，听你这么说，我对 MATLAB 感觉有点沮丧了。

sentences.en: It sounds kind of like a, like, why would I pay this MathWorks company money to have it or go to the effort of using GNU Octave instead of just using C or Python.
sentences.zh: 听起来就像是，我干嘛还要花钱买 MathWorks 公司的产品，或者费劲去用 GNU Octave，而不是直接用 C 或 Python 呢？

sentences.en: But I've had a lot of people at work tell me how awesome MATLAB is.
sentences.zh: 但我身边的很多同事都跟我说 MATLAB 多么厉害。

sentences.en: And then they tell me that they are using, like, you've got to do a huge sparse matrix computation.
sentences.zh: 然后他们告诉我他们在做一些事情，比如你需要做一个巨大的稀疏矩阵计算。

sentences.en: And my eyes cringe thinking I'd have to go write code in C to be able to do that.
sentences.zh: 一想到我得去用 C 语言写代码才能实现这一点，我就直皱眉头。

sentences.en: Or they're doing some Fourier transform.
sentences.zh: 或者他们在做某种傅里叶变换。

sentences.en: And I don't even know.
sentences.zh: 我甚至都不知道那是什么。

sentences.en: It's so complicated I had to look at my textbook to figure out what it was.
sentences.zh: 太复杂了，我得翻课本才能弄明白那到底是什么。

sentences.en: So, why are these guys saying that MATLAB is really powerful and they're able to do those operations fast?
sentences.zh: 所以，为什么这些家伙会说 MATLAB 真的很强大，而且他们还能把这些运算做得很快呢？

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So, MATLAB is extremely optimized.
sentences.zh: 所以，MATLAB 经过了极度的优化。

sentences.en: So, the way this works is, let's say in MATLAB, you want to add two matrices together.
sentences.zh: 它的工作原理是这样的：假设在 MATLAB 中，你想把两个矩阵加在一起。

sentences.en: You don't have to use a for loop like you would in C and loop through all of these matrices and add all of the different values at each index together.
sentences.zh: 你不需要像在 C 语言中那样使用 for 循环去遍历这些矩阵，然后把各个索引处不同的值逐个相加。

sentences.en: You can just say, you know, if you have matrices A and B, you could just say C equals A plus B.
sentences.zh: 你只需要说，如果你有矩阵 A 和 B，你只需要写 C 等于 A 加 B。

sentences.en: And what MATLAB does under the hood is it recognizes that they're matrices and it has a very optimized C version.
sentences.zh: 而 MATLAB 在底层所做的是，它识别出它们是矩阵，并且它有一个高度优化的 C 语言版本。

sentences.en: So, in other words, someone maybe that was their full-time job was just to write this function that adds, you know, and does arithmetic on matrices.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，可能有人他们的全职工作就是专门编写这个函数，用来将矩阵相加并进行矩阵算术运算。

sentences.en: So, they might use SSE instructions.
sentences.zh: 所以，他们可能会使用SSE指令。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So, it'll check and see what the capabilities of your computer are.
sentences.zh: 所以，它会检查并了解你电脑的性能。

sentences.en: If your computer supports SSE instructions, which stands for, what is it, SIMD extensions, standard SIMD extensions.
sentences.zh: 如果你的电脑支持SSE指令——也就是所谓的SIMD扩展，标准SIMD扩展——

sentences.en: And maybe we'll talk about that when we talk about C++.
sentences.zh: 也许我们在聊C++的时候会谈到这个。

sentences.en: Yeah, that could be a whole topic itself probably.
sentences.zh: 对，这本身可能就是一个完整的话题。

sentences.en: Yeah, yeah, definitely.
sentences.zh: 对，对，绝对是。

sentences.en: If your computer has any of these extensions, it'll try and use them.
sentences.zh: 如果你的电脑具备这些扩展中的任何一个，它就会尝试使用它们。

sentences.en: If your computer has a GPU, which is something maybe we'll talk about later, it can use the graphics processing unit to do some of these matrix operations.
sentences.zh: 如果你的电脑配备了GPU——我们以后可能会讨论这个——它就可以利用图形处理器来执行其中一些矩阵运算。

sentences.en: And so, MATLAB will sort of query your hardware and say, you know, based on your configuration, I can add these two matrices even faster using X, Y, and Z.
sentences.zh: 因此，MATLAB会查询你的硬件，然后说，你知道的，根据你的配置，使用X、Y和Z，我甚至能更快地将这两个矩阵相加。

sentences.en: Versus, you know, if you're writing in C, you're probably just going to write the addition code in for loops, and that won't use any of these optimized hardware.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，你知道的，如果你用C语言编写，你可能只会用for循环来写加法代码，而且不会用到任何这些优化的硬件。

sentences.en: I see, I see.
sentences.zh: 原来如此，原来如此。

sentences.en: So, if you're using their functions and using them in a way, so Fourier transform, they've gone in and made that thing awesome.
sentences.zh: 所以，如果你使用他们的函数，并且以某种方式使用它们——比如傅里叶变换，他们已经进去把那个功能做得棒极了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: If I go code one, mine will work and probably beat by far the one that you write yourself in MATLAB.
sentences.zh: 如果我自己去写一个，我的固然能用，但很可能会被你在MATLAB中自己写的代码远远甩在后面。

sentences.en: But they've already taken time to go write one that's kick butt, and it'll sure kick the butt of my code.
sentences.zh: 但他们已经花时间写出了一个非常牛的代码，而且绝对能把我的代码打得落花流水。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: I mean, those guys make a living just figuring out how to do matrix arithmetic and Fourier transform and, you know, cosine transform and things like that.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，那些家伙以研究如何进行矩阵算术、傅里叶变换、余弦变换之类的事情为生。

sentences.en: There's people who that's their job.
sentences.zh: 有专门的人把这当作他们的工作。

sentences.en: And so, they're naturally, they're going to do it and test it and optimize it much better than someone whose job is to do image processing.
sentences.zh: 所以很自然地，他们会比一个把图像处理当作主要工作、只是顺便得做一下傅里叶变换的人，做得更好、测试得更彻底、优化得更到位。

sentences.en: And they're just having to do Fourier transform as a consequence of that.
sentences.zh: 而他们做傅里叶变换只是其中的一部分。

sentences.en: So, they are, you know, highly specialized.
sentences.zh: 所以，你知道的，他们是高度专业化的。

sentences.en: And so, someone using MATLAB, it's sort of, you know, the positives of it is they have the expertise of the low-level, you know, architects that design MATLAB.
sentences.zh: 因此，对于使用MATLAB的人来说，你知道的，它的优点在于他们拥有设计MATLAB的底层架构师的专业知识。

sentences.en: They have that going behind them, even though they don't necessarily know how that stuff works under the hood.
sentences.zh: 有这些作为他们的后盾，尽管他们不一定清楚这些东西在底层是如何运作的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: So, what about Octave?
sentences.zh: 那么，Octave呢？

sentences.en: So, MathWorks has a number of employees.
sentences.zh: MathWorks有很多员工。

sentences.en: I don't know how many.
sentences.zh: 我不知道具体有多少。

sentences.en: I'm sure a lot.
sentences.zh: 我敢说肯定不少。

sentences.en: And they sit here and do all this awesome stuff.
sentences.zh: 他们就坐在那里做所有这些了不起的事情。

sentences.en: And you said earlier something that I thought was interesting.
sentences.zh: 你刚才说了一句我觉得很有意思的话。

sentences.en: Octave is a re-implementation of the MATLAB language or an implementation of it.
sentences.zh: Octave是MATLAB语言的一种重新实现，或者说是一个实现版本。

sentences.en: That it's not MathWorks one because they obviously can't use MathWorks code.
sentences.zh: 它不是MathWorks的产品，因为他们显然不能使用MathWorks的代码。

sentences.en: That's protected.
sentences.zh: 那是受版权保护的。

sentences.en: And they probably can't even look at it because then some of it might accidentally end up in there and they could get in all sorts of trouble.
sentences.zh: 而且他们可能连看都不能看，否则有些代码可能会不小心混进去，那样他们就会惹上各种麻烦。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: So, they recreate all of that stuff.
sentences.zh: 所以，他们把所有这些东西都重新创造了一遍。

sentences.en: So, how does Octave speed compare to MATLAB?
sentences.zh: 那么，Octave的速度跟MATLAB比起来怎么样呢？

sentences.en: So, Octave, from my limited experience, Octave is a little slower than MATLAB.
sentences.zh: 根据我有限的经验，Octave比MATLAB稍微慢一点。

sentences.en: There was a time when I did take some of my code and run it on MATLAB, code that I developed in Octave.
sentences.zh: 曾几何时，我确实把我的一些代码拿到MATLAB上运行过，那些代码是我在Octave里开发的。

sentences.en: I noticed it was slightly faster.
sentences.zh: 我发现它稍微快了一点。

sentences.en: But a lot of the limitations that we've talked about, I mean, a lot of the, especially, you know, people who are novices like myself and MATLAB,
sentences.zh: 但我们谈到的很多局限性，我的意思是，尤其是，你知道的，像我这样在MATLAB方面还是新手的人，

sentences.en: the slowness or the speed will be a result of, you know, using too many lines of code and just hitting the virtual machine too often.
sentences.zh: 这种迟钝或速度慢，往往是因为使用了太多的代码行，并且过于频繁地调用虚拟机造成的。

sentences.en: So, for example, you might want to do something that you think is very complex.
sentences.zh: 所以，举个例子，你可能想做一件你认为非常复杂的事情。

sentences.en: Like, you know, for example, if, you know, you want to loop through the matrix and if the value is greater than 0.5, you want to do something.
sentences.zh: 比如，你知道，比方说，如果你想遍历矩阵，如果数值大于0.5，你就想做点什么。

sentences.en: So, you might think, how am I going to do this without a for loop?
sentences.zh: 所以你可能会想，没有for循环我该怎么做？

sentences.en: Because there's logic here and, you know, I have different branches.
sentences.zh: 因为这里有逻辑判断，而且，你知道，我有不同的分支。

sentences.en: And MATLAB will actually do those things.
sentences.zh: 而MATLAB实际上可以做到这些。

sentences.en: There's single commands that can sort of return all the locations that are greater than 0.5 or greater than some threshold.
sentences.zh: 有一些单一的命令可以返回所有大于0.5或大于某个阈值的位置。

sentences.en: And if you're clever in MATLAB, you can reduce the number of instructions you're giving it and still do really complicated things.
sentences.zh: 如果你在MATLAB里很聪明，你可以减少给它的指令数量，同时还能做出非常复杂的事情。

sentences.en: And if you're doing that, your code is going to be very fast, whether you're using Octave or MATLAB.
sentences.zh: 如果你这么做了，不管你用的是Octave还是MATLAB，你的代码都会非常快。

sentences.en: But, yeah, overall, MATLAB, because they've spent so much time optimizing for different computers, is going to be a little bit faster.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，总的来说，由于MATLAB花了很多时间针对不同的计算机进行优化，所以它会稍微快一点。

sentences.en: Well, I think that that's a pretty good overview of the two languages.
sentences.zh: 好吧，我认为这是对这两种语言相当不错的概述。

sentences.en: Do you have any other comments?
sentences.zh: 你还有其他什么看法吗？

sentences.en: You know, we kind of talk about learning sometimes, but MATLAB, Octave, I mean, there's tons of stuff out there.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我们有时会谈到学习资源，对于MATLAB、Octave，我的意思是，外面有大量的资料。

sentences.en: Lots of good stuff.
sentences.zh: 有很多好东西。

sentences.en: A lot of books written.
sentences.zh: 写了很多书。

sentences.en: A lot of professors use it.
sentences.zh: 很多教授都在使用它。

sentences.en: There's a lot of tutorials on university websites.
sentences.zh: 大学网站上有大量的教程。

sentences.en: And, yeah, that's a good point.
sentences.zh: 是的，这倒是个好观点。

sentences.en: If you're in university, chances are one of your, you know, electrical engineering, computer engineering classes is going to have a, you know, intro on MATLAB.
sentences.zh: 如果你在上大学，你的电气工程、计算机工程课程中很有可能会有一门介绍MATLAB的课程。

sentences.en: Often they won't teach it to you.
sentences.zh: 通常他们不会在课上教你。

sentences.en: You'll have to, you know, they'll leave it up to you to read it.
sentences.zh: 他们会让你自己去阅读。

sentences.en: But at least they'll have the material there.
sentences.zh: 但至少他们有那些学习材料。

sentences.en: And I know that at UCF and probably even at UF, that stuff's public.
sentences.zh: 我知道在中佛罗里达大学（UCF），可能甚至在佛罗里达大学（UF），这些资料都是公开的。

sentences.en: So you could even get on the UCF website and read their tutorial on MATLAB without being a student.
sentences.zh: 所以你甚至不用成为那里的学生，就可以登录UCF的网站阅读他们的MATLAB教程。

sentences.en: Awesome.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Well, you want to close it out there?
sentences.zh: 好吧，你想就在这里收尾吗？

sentences.en: Yeah, unless you have anything to say about MATLAB.
sentences.zh: 可以，除非你对MATLAB还有什么要说的。

sentences.en: What about applications?
sentences.zh: 那应用场景呢？

sentences.en: Like, what kind of stuff?
sentences.zh: 比如，都是些什么类型的？

sentences.en: Did you use MATLAB on your Arduino?
sentences.zh: 你在你的Arduino上用过MATLAB吗？

sentences.en: Probably not, right?
sentences.zh: 大概没有吧？

sentences.en: No, no.
sentences.zh: 没有，没有。

sentences.en: Yeah, so, you know, we talked a little bit about projects using Erlang last week.
sentences.zh: 对，所以，你知道，我们上周稍微聊了一下使用Erlang的项目。

sentences.en: I know that might be a good segment.
sentences.zh: 我知道那可能会是一个不错的话题。

sentences.en: But then for MATLAB, it's a little hard to use.
sentences.zh: 但对于MATLAB来说，它有点难以使用。

sentences.en: People don't – there are some GUIs and stuff written.
sentences.zh: 人们不——虽然也写了一些图形用户界面（GUI）之类的东西。

sentences.en: But because of the nature of most people using MATLAB from MathWorks that, you know,
sentences.zh: 但由于大多数使用MathWorks的MATLAB的人的性质，你知道的，

sentences.en: people don't want – they can't give you a program to run necessarily without you having to buy your own license.
sentences.zh: 人们不愿意——他们不一定能给你一个可以直接运行的程序，除非你自己去买许可证。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: That's expensive proposition.
sentences.zh: 那可是一笔不小的开销。

sentences.en: So there are not a lot of applications written.
sentences.zh: 所以并没有编写太多的应用程序。

sentences.en: But, yeah, I mean, I've used it in school, especially in some at work for doing, like you said, a lot of image processing that was used for it.
sentences.zh: 但是，是的，我的意思是，我在学校里用过它，特别是为了做一些工作上的事情，正如你所说，很多图像处理就是用它做的。

sentences.en: Also doing some linear algebra type stuff like optimizations and stuff there.
sentences.zh: 还有做一些线性代数类的东西，比如优化之类的工作。

sentences.en: And some controls stuff was there as well.
sentences.zh: 还有一些控制系统方面的内容也在其中。

sentences.en: So, yeah, I used it for a number of those kind of projects.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，我在好几个这类项目里用过它。

sentences.en: I never had to write anything that was a substantial line count or a big, complicated project because it's just not really – one time I tried to make a GUI,
sentences.zh: 我从来没有写过代码行数很多或者很大、很复杂的项目，因为它真的不太适合——有一次我试图做一个GUI，

sentences.en: but it's just not – I didn't find it well suited for that.
sentences.zh: 但它就是不太行——我发现它不太适合干这个。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: Yeah, I've noticed the same thing, that MATLAB doesn't really sort of play well with others in the sense that, you know, you can write, as we talked about, those MEX files.
sentences.zh: 是的，我也注意到同样的情况，MATLAB在与其他软件“友好相处”方面确实不太在行，就像我们讨论过的，你可以编写那些MEX文件，

sentences.en: But the interface is very cumbersome.
sentences.zh: 但接口非常繁琐。

sentences.en: And MATLAB works, you know, they're in the business of sort of writing extensions for MATLAB.
sentences.zh: 而且MATLAB在运作时，你知道，他们的业务就是为MATLAB编写扩展。

sentences.en: And if they make it really easy for you to interface MATLAB with other aspects of your system, then they're sort of working against themselves there to some extent.
sentences.zh: 如果他们让你非常容易地将MATLAB与你系统的其他方面进行对接，那么在某种程度上，他们就在跟自己过不去。

sentences.en: But with that said, MATLAB is a phenomenal tool for prototyping, for doing data analysis.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，MATLAB仍然是用于原型开发和数据分析的一个了不起的工具。

sentences.en: One thing we didn't talk about, but MATLAB comes with a graphing, you know, tool built in.
sentences.zh: 我们漏掉没谈的一点是，MATLAB内置了一个绘图工具。

sentences.en: So you can actually go into MATLAB or Octave, you can download Octave right now, type in sine of X, and it'll actually display a graph of the sine wave on your computer.
sentences.zh: 所以你实际上可以进入MATLAB或Octave——你现在就可以下载Octave——输入sine of X，它就会在你的计算机上显示正弦波的图表。

sentences.en: And so that is just all of this extra visualization tools that you don't get in many languages.
sentences.zh: 因此，所有这些你在许多语言中都找不到的额外可视化工具，

sentences.en: It makes it great for doing a quick prototype before jumping into C or C++.
sentences.zh: 使得它在跳转到C或C++之前非常适合做快速原型开发。

sentences.en: Yeah, definitely.
sentences.zh: 对，绝对是。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好了。

sentences.en: Well, if you haven't checked out our blog at programmingthrowdown.blogspot.com, make sure to check that out.
sentences.zh: 那么，如果你还没看过我们的博客 programmingthrowdown.blogspot.com，记得去看看。

sentences.en: Also, if you haven't left a review for us or given us a star rating, please go ahead and do that.
sentences.zh: 另外，如果你还没给我们写过评论或给过星级评分，请赶紧去评一下。

sentences.en: If you love us, make sure to tell us.
sentences.zh: 如果你爱我们，一定要告诉我们。

sentences.en: If you hate us, well, you can tell us that too.
sentences.zh: 如果你恨我们，好吧，你也可以告诉我们。

sentences.en: Rate us five stars because we're so hate-inducing.
sentences.zh: 给我们打五星吧，因为我们太招人恨了。

sentences.en: So, yeah, go ahead and leave your – and those of you who have, thank you a bunch.
sentences.zh: 所以，是的，尽管留下你们的——对于那些已经留过的人，非常感谢你们。

sentences.en: It's really encouraging.
sentences.zh: 这真的很让人鼓舞。

sentences.en: It helps us keep our spirits up and wanting to keep doing this.
sentences.zh: 它帮助我们保持高昂的士气，并愿意继续做下去。

sentences.en: And hopefully, we'll continue to hear back from some of you about what you like or what you don't like, what you'd like to see in the future,
sentences.zh: 希望我们能继续收到你们的一些反馈，告诉我们你们喜欢什么、不喜欢什么、以后想看到什么，

sentences.en: what you'd prefer for us to stop doing.
sentences.zh: 或者你们希望我们停止做什么。

sentences.en: How much you love Jason or how much you love me, either one will work.
sentences.zh: 你们有多爱杰森或者有多爱我，哪个都行。

sentences.en: And, yeah, check it out.
sentences.zh: 还有，去看看吧。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 对。

sentences.en: If you don't give us any love on iTunes, we might have to start Lacrimology, which is – this is off Wikipedia here.
sentences.zh: 如果你不在iTunes上给我们一点爱，我们可能不得不开始研究“悲泣疗法（Lacrimology）”了——这是从维基百科上看到的——

sentences.en: A religion that supposedly embraces pain and its release through crying as a means to move to a highter state of being.
sentences.zh: 这是一种宗教，据说崇尚痛苦并通过哭泣来释放痛苦，以此作为进入更高境界的手段。

sentences.en: This is –
sentences.zh: 这是——

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: With that, I think we're going to be done.
sentences.zh: 差不多就这样，我们这期节目就到这里。

sentences.en: Until next time.
sentences.zh: 直到下次再见。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Have a good one, guys.
sentences.zh: 大家过得愉快。

sentences.en: Keep on programming.
sentences.zh: 继续编程。
